title: 指标口径：先数对象，再算比例
Metric contracts: identify entities before dividing
explain: 退款率首先是一个集合的约定：分母包含哪些订单，分子包含其中哪些退款订单。一次订单发生两次退款，只增加退款事件数，不会把该订单变成两个客户或两笔订单。先给实体一个稳定的键，才能谈“去重后有多少”。

An order refund rate is a contract over two sets: eligible orders and the refunded orders within them. Two refund events on one order do not create two orders. A stable entity key makes the distinction testable.
观察窗口决定什么时候可以说“未退款”。若约定统计下单后7天内发生的退款，昨天的新单尚未成熟；成熟订单第9天的退款也不能计入7天分子。分子、分母必须来自同一订单队列；本月退款事件可能对应上月订单。

The follow-up contract specifies refunds occurring within seven days of purchase. Yesterday’s order is immature; a mature order’s day-nine refund is outside the seven-day numerator. Both sets must share a cohort; refund-month events can refer to earlier orders.

title: 一张可复算的7天退款指标卡
A reproducible seven-day refund contract
given: 合成数据：A、B、C、D均已观察满10天；E仅满2天。A在下单后第2和第5天各退款一次，C在第6天退款，B在第9天退款，D和E无退款记录。本例统计下单后7天内、按订单计的退款率。

Synthetic input: A–D each have ten days of follow-up; E has two. A has refunds on days two and five, C on day six and B on day nine; D/E have none. Measure the order-level rate of refunds within seven days of purchase.

title: 建立适用队列
Build eligibility
detail: 成熟订单集合为{A,B,C,D}，共4笔；E记“观察未满”，不将它归入未退款集合。这样每个分母成员都有相同的观察机会。
The mature cohort is {A,B,C,D}, four orders. E is marked immature rather than unrefunded, so every denominator member has equal follow-up.

title: 识别退款实体
Identify refunded entities
detail: 先筛下单后7天内的退款事件，再在成熟队列内按order_id去重，得到{A,C}共2笔。B第9天的退款不计入本指标；A的两条窗口内事件保留追溯，分子只计1笔A。

First select refunds occurring within seven days, then deduplicate mature-cohort order IDs to get {A,C}. B’s day-nine refund is excluded from this metric. Keep both eligible A events for audit while counting A once.

title: 计算并写清名称
Calculate and name
detail: 2÷4=50%。另列窗口内退款事件3次、窗口外退款事件1次、观察未满订单1笔。指标名写“成熟下单队列的7天订单退款率”，不将事件次数或以后发生的退款混入。
2/4=50%. Separately report three in-window events, one out-of-window event and one immature order. Name the seven-day mature-cohort order rate without mixing events or later refunds.

result: 7天订单退款率50%，窗口内退款事件3次、窗口外1次、未成熟订单1笔；每个计数都能从给定日期复算。
Seven-day order refund rate 50%; three in-window events, one out-of-window event and one immature order. Every count is reproducible from the supplied timing.

wrong: 把3次退款除以5笔订单，得到60%退款率。
Divide three events by five orders and report a 60% order refund rate.
why: 分子用了事件粒度，分母又混入观察未满的E。即使算术没有错，指标含义仍不成立。
The numerator uses events while the denominator includes immature E. Correct arithmetic cannot repair the mismatched contract.
correct: 先固定实体、适用集合和观察截止，再对分子订单去重，并单独报告未成熟数量。
Fix entity, eligibility and follow-up before deduplicating refunded orders; report immature orders separately.

prompt: 合成新例：8笔订单都已满14天；一笔在前14天退款3次，另一笔在前14天退款1次，其余无退款。按订单计的14天退款率是多少？
Synthetic new example: eight orders each have 14 days of follow-up. One has three refunds within those 14 days, another one, and the rest none. What is the 14-day order refund rate?

feedback: 4是退款事件数；本题要数发生退款的不同订单。
Four counts events; the question asks for distinct refunded orders.
两笔不同订单发生退款，且都属于8笔成熟订单队列，分子分母粒度一致。
Two distinct orders are refunded within the eight-order mature cohort.
4不是适用订单集合大小，不能用事件条数替换分母。
Four is not the eligible cohort size and cannot replace its denominator.

prompt: 统计7天订单退款率：10笔订单中2笔未满7天；8笔成熟订单中3笔在下单后7天内退款，其中1笔在该窗口退款两次，其余没有窗口内退款。写指标卡与结果。

Measure a seven-day order refund rate: two of ten orders are immature. Among eight mature orders, three refund within seven days, one twice within that window; no others do. Write the metric contract and result.
sample: 本例成熟订单8笔，退款订单3笔，退款率37.5%；退款事件4次，未成熟2笔。指标卡保留下单队列、观察期、order_id和排除原因。
Eight mature orders, three refunded orders: 37.5%. Separately record four events and two immature orders, with cohort, window, key and exclusions.
criteria: 分子中的每个order_id都能在适用分母中找到，重复事件未重复计实体。
Every numerator order belongs to the denominator; repeated events do not duplicate entities.
指标卡写明观察期与未成熟处理；结果没有把未知写成未发生。
The contract states follow-up and immature handling; unknown outcomes are not called absent.

title: SQL关联：看见每个键怎样展开
SQL joins: follow the rows produced by each key
explain: 连接不是把两张表平放到一起，而是为满足条件的行对生成结果。订单表一行一单，明细表一行一商品；一笔订单有两条明细，就会在连接结果出现两次。LEFT JOIN只保证保留左表未匹配的行，不保证结果仍是一行一单。
A join produces matching pairs, not a side-by-side spreadsheet. An order with two lines appears twice after joining. LEFT JOIN preserves unmatched left rows, not the original one-row-per-order grain.
ON规定哪些右表行可以匹配；WHERE在匹配完成后筛结果。右表无匹配时其字段是NULL，WHERE right_amount>0不会保留这些行。若目标是每单一行，应先把明细汇总到订单粒度，再连接，而不是用DISTINCT金额遮住重复。

ON determines matches; WHERE filters the joined result. An unmatched right value is NULL and does not satisfy right_amount>0. To retain one row per order, aggregate lines before joining rather than applying DISTINCT to money.

title: 从三行明细得到两行订单结果
From line matches back to two order rows
given: 合成订单A金额80、B金额30；明细A有商品金额20和15，B无明细。要求每单一行，同时显示订单金额和明细合计。
Synthetic orders: A=80 and B=30. A has lines 20 and 15; B has none. Return one row per order with order amount and line total.

title: 先预测直接连接
Predict the raw join
detail: 直接左连接产生A/20、A/15、B/NULL三行。此时SUM(order_amount)=80+80+30=190，而原订单合计是110；偏差来自A被展开，并非订单原值错误。
The raw left join yields A/20, A/15 and B/NULL. Order amounts sum to 190 instead of 110 because A is repeated.

title: 先汇总右表
Aggregate the detail
detail: SELECT order_id, SUM(line_amount) AS line_total FROM lines GROUP BY order_id 得到A/35。它现在与订单表同为订单粒度；检查order_id唯一后再连接。
Grouping lines by order_id and summing line_amount produces A/35. Verify unique grouped keys before joining.

title: 保留未匹配订单
Preserve unmatched orders
detail: orders LEFT JOIN line_totals USING(order_id) 输出A/80/35和B/30/NULL。NULL表示没有匹配的明细合计；是否显示0由业务定义决定，不能默默改写。
The final left join returns A/80/35 and B/30/NULL. NULL means no matching line total; whether to display zero requires a declared business rule.

result: 输出2行、不同订单2个、订单金额总计110；三项共同核对，比只看查询能运行更可靠。
Two output rows, two distinct orders and an order total of 110 reconcile the intended grain.

wrong: 在直接连接后写SUM(DISTINCT order_amount)修复金额。
Use SUM(DISTINCT order_amount) after the raw join.
why: 不同订单可能恰好同金额；DISTINCT按值去重，会把合法订单金额一起删掉。
Different legitimate orders can have equal amounts; value deduplication removes them too.
correct: 按业务键先确定目标粒度，再汇总或连接；分别核对行数、不同键数与金额。
Define the target grain by business key and reconcile row count, distinct keys and totals.

prompt: 订单C和D各50元；C有两条明细、D无明细。直接左连接后SUM(DISTINCT订单金额)是多少，是否正确？
Orders C and D each cost 50. C has two lines and D none. What does SUM(DISTINCT order_amount) return after joining?

feedback: DISTINCT只看到一个不同的数值50，不会按订单保留两个50。
DISTINCT sees one distinct value, 50; it does not preserve one amount per order.
150是直接连接的重复金额总和，不是DISTINCT结果，也不符合原订单总额。
150 is the duplicated raw sum, not the distinct sum or original order total.
DISTINCT金额误合并了C与D；应按订单粒度保留两个实体。
Equal amounts from C and D are incorrectly merged. Preserve distinct order entities.

prompt: 订单K=40、L=25；K明细8和12，L无明细。写一行一单结果，并说明将line_amount>10放ON或WHERE时L如何变化。
Orders K=40 and L=25; K has lines 8 and 12, L none. Give one row per order and explain ON versus WHERE for line_amount>10.
sample: 先汇总得K明细20，输出K/40/20与L/25/NULL，订单总计65。原始明细筛选放ON时L仍保留；放WHERE时L因NULL条件不成立而消失。
Aggregate to K=20; return K/40/20 and L/25/NULL, total 65. On the raw join, an ON filter retains L; a right-side WHERE filter removes it.
criteria: 中间表粒度明确，未用DISTINCT金额代替实体去重。
The intermediate grain is explicit; amounts are not used as entity keys.
给出无匹配行及ON/WHERE的不同结果，保留NULL解释。
Unmatched rows and ON/WHERE outcomes are shown with the meaning of NULL.

title: 分组汇总：整体比例从哪里来
Aggregation: build an overall rate from its components
explain: 分组汇总把多行压成一个组，因此必须先决定每行代表什么。WHERE先决定参与的原行，GROUP BY把它们组成组，HAVING再筛选已得到的组。COUNT(*)数行；COUNT(amount)只数amount非NULL的行，两者回答不同问题。
Aggregation compresses rows into groups. WHERE chooses input rows, GROUP BY forms groups and HAVING filters groups afterward. COUNT(*) and COUNT(amount) differ when amounts are NULL.
比例不是可直接相加的金额。把两个退款率等权平均，相当于假设两组大小一样；总体退款率应重新合并退款数和订单数。筛完组之后再算总计，则已经换了总体，必须重新命名。
Rates are not additive amounts. Averaging two rates gives equal weight to groups, whereas an overall rate combines component counts. Recomputing after filtering groups changes the population.

title: 小渠道与大渠道怎样合成总计
Combining a small and a large channel
given: 合成原始orders表一行一订单，channel标渠道，refunded取0或1且每单最多计一次。按channel分组后：A有20单、退款2单；B有80单、退款16单。先求各渠道与整体退款率，再保留订单数至少50的渠道。

The synthetic raw orders table has one row per order, a channel field and refunded=0 or 1, counting each order once. Grouping yields A:20 orders/2 refunds; B:80/16. Compute cohort and overall rates, then retain channels with at least 50 orders.

title: 列出分子分母
Expose component counts
detail: A为2/20=10%，B为16/80=20%。把refunds和orders一起放进结果，读者才知道B是A的4倍样本，不会把两个百分比等量对待。
A is 10% and B 20%. Retaining refunds and orders exposes the fourfold difference in group size.

title: 合并后重新除
Recompute the combined rate
detail: 整体退款18单、订单100单，所以18/100=18%。(10%+20%)/2=15%给了A过高权重，不能作为这100笔订单的退款率。
The combined counts are 18/100, or 18%. The unweighted mean, 15%, overweights the small channel.

title: 区分组筛选后的总体
Separate filtered totals
detail: 在这一行一订单的orders表上GROUP BY channel HAVING COUNT(*)>=50，只保留B，筛后为16/80=20%。如果输入已经是一行一渠道的汇总表，就应按orders列筛选，不能再把COUNT(*)当订单数；两种总计分别标“全部渠道”与“至少50单的渠道”。

On this one-row-per-order table, GROUP BY channel HAVING COUNT(*)>=50 retains B, giving 16/80=20%. If the input is already one row per channel, filter its orders count rather than interpreting COUNT(*) as order volume. Label all-channel and minimum-size totals separately.

result: 各组10%与20%，整体18%，筛后20%；不同结果来自不同集合，不是算式任意选择。
Group rates are 10% and 20%, overall 18%, filtered 20%; each belongs to a declared population.

wrong: 先把各组比例舍入，再求平均作为总体。
Round group percentages and average them as the overall rate.
why: 这既丢失组大小，也可能累积舍入误差；只看到百分比无法恢复可靠的总计。
This loses group sizes and can add rounding error. Percentages alone do not establish a combined total.
correct: 保留原始计数，先合并再除，最后展示时舍入。
Retain counts, aggregate before division and round for display.

prompt: 新例：C为1/10，D为9/90。整体退款率是哪一项？
New case: C has 1/10 and D 9/90. What is the combined refund rate?

feedback: 分子1+9、分母10+90，合并后的统计对象仍是100笔订单。
Add numerators and denominators to describe the same 100 orders.
只用了D的分母，却把C的退款也加入了分子。
The numerator includes C but the denominator does not.
订单数应该相加，两个互斥渠道的订单数不能相乘。
Counts in disjoint channels are added, not multiplied.

prompt: 地区E有30单、3退款，F有70单、14退款。制作含计数、各组比例、总计及至少50单组筛选的汇总表。
E has 30 orders and three refunds; F has 70 and 14. Create a table with counts, group rates, overall rate and a minimum-50-order filter.
sample: E=10%、F=20%、全部17%；筛选后仅F，为20%。总计应注明筛选前后；空集合或零分母显示未定义而不是0%。
E=10%, F=20%, overall=17%; only F remains after filtering, at 20%. Label filtering scope and handle empty denominators as undefined.
criteria: 汇总结果保留可复算的原始分子分母，总数与分组相加一致。
Component counts remain available and reconcile to totals.
总计注明所描述的组集合，零分母不伪造为零率。
Totals name the included population; zero denominators are not presented as zero rates.

title: 缺失数据：未知不是零
Missing data: unknown is not zero
explain: 缺记录与缺值发生在两个层次：应收到的订单没有整行到达，是记录缺失；订单到了但金额为空，是字段缺失。金额0则是已知的零值。把空白统一填0，会把“没看到”改成“确定为零”，均值和覆盖率都随之改变。
A missing row differs from a row with a missing value. Zero is an observed value. Filling every blank with zero asserts a measurement that was never observed and changes both means and coverage.
计算均值时，分母通常是有效观测数；判断交付完整性时，分母可能是应收记录数。它们没有天然相同的分母。还需要先排除错误类型：字符“坏值”不是正常缺失，插补值也不能冒充原始观测。
The mean uses valid measurements; delivery completeness may use expected records. These denominators serve different purposes. Invalid strings and imputed values also require separate flags.

title: 同一批数据为什么有两个覆盖率
Why one batch has two coverage rates
given: 合成数据：预期6笔读数，收到5行金额12、空白、0、24、空白。空白代表没有观测，0确认是实际读数。
Synthetic input: six readings expected, five rows received: 12, blank, 0, 24, blank. Blanks are unobserved; zero is genuine.

title: 先数到达情况
Count arrivals
detail: 收到5/6行，记录到达率约83.33%；缺了哪一个实体ID需另查，不能凭金额列空白来代替整行缺失检查。
Five of six rows arrived: 83.33%. Missing entity IDs must be checked separately from blank amount fields.

title: 再数有效金额
Count measured values
detail: 有效金额是12、0、24，共3个；金额字段覆盖率为3/5=60%。0保留为有效测量，否则分母会错误减为2。
Three measured values, including zero, give amount coverage 3/5 = 60%. Dropping zero would incorrectly reduce the count.

title: 明确均值集合
State the mean population
detail: 有效金额和为36，均值36/3=12。若把两个空值填0再除5，会得到7.2；这是另一种带插补假设的估计，不是原始有效均值。
Observed sum is 36 and mean 12. Zero-imputing blanks produces 7.2, an assumption-dependent estimate rather than the observed mean.

result: 到达率5/6、金额覆盖3/5、有效均值12，三项分别报告；没有一项可以替代另外两项。
Report arrival 5/6, amount coverage 3/5 and observed mean 12 separately.

wrong: 为了让图表完整，把全部空值改为0后不再保留原列。
Replace blanks with zero and discard the raw column to complete the chart.
why: 之后无法判断哪些零是实际测量、哪些是人为填补，也无法复查插补对总体结论的影响。
Observed and invented zeroes become indistinguishable, preventing a review of imputation effects.
correct: 保留raw_amount、缺失原因和插补标记；发布时明确哪些统计只使用有效观测。
Retain raw values, missingness reasons and imputation flags; identify statistics based on observed values.

prompt: 新例收到金额5、NULL、0、15四行。只按有效观测求均值，应为多少？
New input: 5, NULL, 0 and 15. What is the mean of observed values?

feedback: 分母4包括未知的NULL，等价于没有说明的填零。
Including NULL in the divisor silently assumes zero.
5、0、15三项均为有效观测，NULL不参加均值。
Five, zero and 15 are the three observed values.
0不是缺失。删除真实零会把有效观测均值抬高。
Zero is observed; removing it inflates the mean.

prompt: 预期5行，收到4行：8、空、0、16。写到达率、字段覆盖率、有效均值与一条缺失调查记录。
Five rows expected, four received: 8, blank, 0, 16. Report arrival, value coverage, observed mean and one investigation item.
sample: 到达4/5=80%；字段有效3/4=75%；均值24/3=8。调查未到达ID及空白来源，保留原列，不直接推断未知金额。
Arrival 80%, value coverage 75%, observed mean 8. Investigate the missing ID and blank source without inventing an amount.
criteria: 零、空值、缺整行和非法值没有混为一类。
Zeroes, missing values, absent rows and invalid values remain distinct.
每项统计写明自己的分母，插补与原始观测可区分。
Each measure names its denominator; imputed and observed values are distinguishable.

title: 重复与冲突：同一个键不等于同一条事实
Duplicates and conflicts: a shared key is not identical evidence
explain: 完全相同的业务记录可能是重复传输，但相同订单号、不同金额也可能是更正、历史版本或冲突。先定义业务键和生效规则，才知道哪些行能折叠。“保留第一行”只利用文件位置，并没有说明为什么这一行更可信。
An identical business record may be a retransmission, while one ID with different amounts may be a correction, history or conflict. Identity and effective-time rules must precede deduplication.
去重不应切断证据链。为原行保留ID，登记代表行与被折叠行的映射。没有可信版本、时间或权威来源时，同键不同值应留待裁决；暂不发布受冲突影响的精确总额，比自动挑金额较大的一行更可靠。

Deduplication should preserve provenance. Retain raw row IDs and representative mappings. Without trustworthy version or authority, conflicting rows remain unresolved rather than selecting the largest amount.

title: 保留零值并把真正冲突留出来
Retain genuine zeroes and isolate conflicts
given: 合成原行：r1 A=8、r2 A=8、r3 B=9、r4 B=11、r5 C=0。各行无版本或更新时间，金额均为有效输入。
Synthetic rows: r1 A=8, r2 A=8, r3 B=9, r4 B=11, r5 C=0. No version or update time is supplied.

title: 按业务键比较字段
Compare by business key
detail: A的两行所有业务字段相同，属于完全重复；B同键金额不同，属于冲突；C只有一行且0有效。不能只看“键出现两次”就把A和B同样处理。
A has identical business fields, B has conflicting amounts and C has one valid zero. Repeated keys alone do not distinguish them.

title: 折叠可解释的重复
Collapse supported duplicates
detail: 保留A的一行，并登记其来源包含r1和r2。C原样保留。B两行暂存到冲突清单，附r3/r4和缺失的裁决依据。
Retain one A with provenance r1/r2, keep C and place both B values in a conflict log with missing resolution evidence.

title: 对账实体与状态
Reconcile identities and states
detail: 最终仍覆盖A、B、C三个键；A与C可用于已确认合计8，B金额未决。不要把11当成“最新”，也不要把已确认小计8命名为全部总额。
A, B and C remain covered. A and C contribute a confirmed subtotal of 8; B is unresolved. Neither 11 nor the subtotal is a justified complete total.

result: 一条重复映射、一组未决冲突、一条真实零值都可回查。数据变少不代表质量问题已全部解决。
The duplicate mapping, unresolved conflict and genuine zero remain traceable. Fewer rows do not imply full resolution.

wrong: 按文件顺序取B最后一行，声称金额11是最新值。
Take B’s last file row and call 11 the latest value.
why: 文件排列不是业务生效顺序，输入也没有更新时间。这个选择制造了不存在的版本依据。
File order is not business time, and no update timestamp exists.
correct: 记录B=9/11及原行号，向来源负责人确认版本或裁决规则后再发布。
Retain B=9/11 and raw IDs until an authoritative version rule is established.

prompt: 新例同键X分别为20与20，Y分别为30与35且没有时间。哪种处理合适？
X appears as 20/20; Y as 30/35 without timestamps. Which handling is justified?

text: X折叠且保留来源；Y留冲突待查
Collapse X with provenance; retain Y as unresolved
feedback: 完全相同与同键不同值被分开处理，且没有补造时间依据。
Identical observations are separated from conflicts without inventing time evidence.

text: Take the larger value for both
feedback: 金额大小不是可信度或时间规则，会掩盖Y的真实冲突。
Amount is not a rule for authority or recency.
这会连X的合法实体一起移除，改变键覆盖范围。
This removes legitimate entities, including X.

prompt: 原行P=7重复两条，Q=4/6冲突两条，R=0一条。制作代表行映射和待裁决清单。
P=7 is duplicated, Q has 4/6 conflicts and R=0 appears once. Build a representative mapping and conflict log.
sample: P保留1行、映射两条来源；Q保留两个候选并注明缺权威规则；R保留0。只报告P/R已确认小计7，Q未决，不能给出唯一全部总额。
Retain one P with both sources, both unresolved Q candidates and R=0. Report confirmed subtotal 7 separately from unresolved Q.
criteria: 每条折叠或未决记录能回到原始行。
Every collapsed or unresolved record traces to raw rows.
冲突有明确待补依据，不用文件位置或金额冒充权威。
Resolution names missing authority instead of using file order or amount.

title: 质量规则：先说明用途与适用人群
Quality rules: define purpose and applicability
explain: 完整性检查一个应有字段是否有值；有效性检查已有值是否符合格式或值域。两者不能互相代替：字符串“ABCDE”可能有值却不是允许的邮编。规则还需要适用条件，否则本不需要邮寄的订单会被错误判为缺邮编。

Completeness asks whether a required value exists; validity asks whether it conforms. A populated string may be invalid. Applicability prevents rules from flagging records that do not require the field.
一条可运行的质量规则包含适用集合、判定条件、失败样本、负责人和复测条件。失败率只描述该规则在该用途中的表现，不自动保证事实准确；格式合格的假地址仍然可能无法投递。
An operational rule names its population, predicate, failing rows, owner and recheck. Conformance within a declared use is not proof that a value is true.

title: 把“质量不好”拆成两个可检查结果
Turn vague quality concerns into two measurable rules
given: 合成40笔订单：30笔需要邮寄，其中3笔邮编为空、2笔邮编含非法字符；10笔为数字商品，不需要邮编。
Synthetic input: 40 orders, of which 30 require shipping. Three shipping postcodes are missing and two malformed; ten digital orders require no postcode.

title: 限定规则适用集合
Define applicability
detail: 适用条件是requires_shipping=true，分母30。数字商品的10笔从这两条邮编规则中排除，并记录原因；不是删除订单。
The eligible set has 30 shipping orders. Ten digital orders are excluded from postcode rules with a reason, not deleted.

title: 分别检查有值与格式
Separate presence and format
detail: 完整性失败3/30=10%。剩下27个已填值中2个格式失败；若有效性分母约定为已填值，则2/27≈7.41%，不要偷偷换成30。
Completeness fails for 3/30 = 10%. Among 27 populated values, validity fails for 2/27, about 7.41%, under a populated-value definition.

title: 给出可执行修复交接
Make remediation actionable
detail: 记录5个失败订单ID、各自失败类型、补录或格式确认负责人。修复后重跑同一适用集合与规则版本，确认没有把空值伪填成通过格式的占位值。
Log the five failing IDs, categories and remediation owners. Recheck the same scope and version, rejecting placeholder fixes that merely pass the pattern.

result: 输出两条规则及各自分母、5个失败样本和复测记录，而不是一个缺乏含义的“质量分”。
The output contains two rules with denominators, five failing examples and a recheck record, not an opaque quality score.

wrong: 把数字商品也算进分母，用3/40宣称邮编缺失率下降。
Use all 40 orders to make missing-postcode rate appear lower.
why: 没有修复任何邮寄订单，只改变了适用集合，导致指标不可比。
No shipping record was repaired; only the denominator changed.
correct: 规则先定义适用集合；版本变化时同时说明分母和影响范围。
Define applicability first and disclose denominator changes with rule versions.

prompt: 20笔订单中12笔需邮寄，2笔缺邮编。完整性规则的失败率应如何算？
Of 20 orders, 12 require shipping and two lack postcodes. What is the completeness failure rate?

feedback: 表的总行数不是本条邮编规则的适用集合。
The table size is not this postcode rule’s eligible population.
数字商品无需此字段，不能把不适用判成失败。
Non-applicable digital orders are not failures.
分母与规则用途一致；结果约16.67%，同时列出两笔失败ID。
This denominator matches the rule’s purpose: about 16.67%, with the two failing IDs.

prompt: 某活动有50个报名，40人需要发证书，4人缺证书姓名、3人姓名含不允许字符。定义两条规则和修复验收。
An event has 50 registrations; 40 need certificates. Four names are missing and three contain forbidden characters. Define rules and remediation acceptance.
sample: 完整性失败4/40；若只对已填写姓名检格式，有效性失败3/36。记录不需证书10人的排除原因，保留失败ID和修复后同版本复跑结果。
Completeness fails for 4/40; populated-name validity fails for 3/36. Record exclusions, failing IDs and same-version rechecks.
criteria: 完整性与有效性条件分开，分母及不适用原因明确。
Presence and validity are separate, with explicit denominators and exclusions.
修复记录指向具体ID、负责人和可重复复测，不以占位值糊弄通过。
Remediation links IDs, owners and repeatable checks rather than placeholder compliance.

title: 描述统计：典型值与尾部是两件事
Describe both the typical case and the tail
explain: 均值回答“总量平均分给每次观测是多少”，中位数回答“排序后中间在哪里”。长尾中的少数很大数值会明显推高均值，却可能不改变中间位置。两种统计没有谁天然更高级，要看读者是在估算总资源还是理解典型体验。
The mean divides total burden across observations; the median locates the middle ranked case. A few large values can move the mean without moving the middle. Choose according to the question.
极端值不能看到就删。它可能是测量错误，也可能是少数用户真实承受的糟糕体验。先回查单位、重复记录和原始时间，再决定是否排除，并同时保留原始与排除后的结果。小样本分位数还取决于计算定义。

An extreme value may be an error or a genuine bad experience. Inspect units and raw records before exclusion, and retain results with and without justified exclusions. Small-sample quantiles also depend on their definition.

title: 一条慢请求如何改变平均体验
How one slow request changes the average
given: 合成五次处理耗时：2、3、4、5、36秒，均确认同单位且无重复；要描述典型体验和资源负担。
Five synthetic durations are 2, 3, 4, 5 and 36 seconds, with consistent units and no duplicates.

title: 排序定位
Locate the middle
detail: 序列已排序，第3个值4秒是中位数；有两次比它短、两次比它长。
The third value, four seconds, is the median, with two observations on either side.

title: 计算总量分摊
Divide the total
detail: 总耗时50秒，50/5=10秒为均值。36秒占总耗时72%，说明少量慢请求主导资源负担。
The total is 50 seconds and the mean ten. The slow request accounts for 72% of the total.

title: 联合解释
Combine the interpretation
detail: 典型位置4秒，但存在36秒的尾部；不删这条，也不只写“平均10秒所以每个用户等10秒”。
The middle is four seconds, with a 36-second tail. Neither deleting it nor saying every user waits ten seconds is justified.

result: 报告n=5、均值10秒、中位数4秒、最大36秒，并保留慢请求的调查入口。
Report n=5, mean ten seconds, median four and maximum 36, with a trace to the slow request.

wrong: 为了让平均值好看，直接删除36秒。
Delete 36 seconds to improve the average.
why: 没有测量错误证据，这会删除最需要改进的真实体验。
Without evidence of measurement error, this erases the experience most in need of improvement.
correct: 先查原始记录，再报告尾部及明确的排除依据。
Investigate the record and document any exclusion.

prompt: 合成耗时1、2、3、4、40秒；中位数是多少？
For synthetic durations 1,2,3,4,40 seconds, what is the median?

feedback: 这是总和50除5得到的均值，不是排序中位数。
Ten is the mean, not the middle ranked value.
排序后第3个观测为3秒；40秒仍需在尾部信息中保留。
The third ordered value is three; retain the 40-second tail separately.
40是最大值，代表尾部而不是中间位置。
Forty is the maximum, not the middle.

prompt: 耗时4、5、6、7、48秒，写三句能同时说明典型体验、总量和后续调查的摘要。
For durations 4,5,6,7,48, summarize typical experience, total burden and investigation.
sample: 中位数6秒，均值70/5=14秒；48秒占总耗时约68.57%。先调查慢请求的真实链路，不能仅因其大就删。
Median six seconds, mean 14; the slow case contributes about 68.57% of total time. Investigate rather than discard it.
criteria: 均值、中位数与样本量可手算复核。
Mean, median and sample size can be independently recomputed.
尾部有原始证据与调查动作，排除不由数值难看决定。
Tail evidence is preserved; exclusion is not based on aesthetics.

title: 抽样：样本多不等于覆盖完整
Sampling: size does not repair missing coverage
explain: 目标总体是想描述的人群，抽样框是实际能抽到的人群。只在App里发问卷，会漏掉不使用App的人；把同一渠道的样本从一千增加到一万，只能减少部分随机波动，不能让漏掉的人自动出现。
The target population differs from the sampling frame. An app-only survey misses non-users; increasing responses within that frame does not repair the missing coverage.
分层加权解决的是“各层在样本中比例不对”，前提是知道总体各层比例，而且层内响应者能代表该层。若某层完全没有样本，不能只靠权重算出它的满意度。非响应偏差也不会因为样本大就消失。
Post-stratification can correct known group proportions when respondents represent their groups. It cannot estimate an entirely unsampled group or automatically remove non-response bias.

title: 平衡样本如何描述不平衡总体
A balanced sample from an unbalanced population
given: 合成总体新用户占20%、老用户占80%。样本两组各50人，满意率分别90%和50%。
Synthetic population: 20% new and 80% returning users. The sample has 50 of each, with satisfaction rates 90% and 50%.

title: 看清样本构成
Inspect sample composition
detail: 直接样本满意率为(45+25)/100=70%；它把两类用户各给50%权重，与总体20/80不一致。
The direct sample rate is 70%, using equal group weights rather than the population’s 20/80 mix.

title: 按目标总体组合
Apply target weights
detail: 0.2×90%+0.8×50%=58%。加权值描述指定总体构成，不是把样本中的个人回答改写。
The weighted estimate is 58%. Weighting changes group contribution, not individual responses.

title: 写出可检验假设
State coverage assumptions
detail: 58%依赖层内样本具有代表性以及总体占比可靠。若新用户只来自高活跃人群，仍需补充覆盖调查，不能称58%为无偏真值。
The 58% estimate relies on representative within-group responses and trustworthy population shares; active-user selection can still bias it.

result: 直接样本70%、按已知层比例估计58%，并列层内代表性与非响应限制。
Distinguish the 70% sample rate from the 58% weighted estimate and disclose remaining selection limitations.

wrong: 样本有一万人，所以不必检查没有App的用户。
Ten thousand responses eliminate the need to consider non-app users.
why: 样本量没有改变抽样框；缺席人群依然无法被观察。
The frame remains unchanged; absent groups remain unobserved.
correct: 画出总体到抽样框到响应者的覆盖关系，补齐缺席群体或明确范围。
Map population, frame and respondents; improve coverage or narrow the claim.

prompt: 总体A占75%、B占25%，两层满意率60%和100%。合成加权估计是哪项？
Population shares are A=75%, B=25%, with satisfaction 60% and 100%. Which weighted estimate is correct?

feedback: The weighted calculation is 70%, subject to within-group representativeness.
这是两层比例的简单平均，忽略总体构成。
This is the unweighted group average.
不能直接相加两个不同人群的百分比。
Percentages for different populations are not added directly.

prompt: 总体移动端70%、桌面端30%；满意率80%和40%，但桌面端只在工作日抽样。算估计并标一项仍需调查的偏差。
Mobile share is 70%, desktop 30%, with satisfaction 80% and 40%. Desktop was sampled only on weekdays. Calculate and qualify.
sample: 加权68%；桌面周末用户可能没被代表，需补采或将结论限于已覆盖时间范围。
The estimate is 68%; weekend desktop users may be unrepresented, requiring more coverage or narrower scope.
criteria: 总体权重与样本权重分开，算式及总体定义可核对。
Population and sample weights are distinguished and reproducible.
说明加权无法修复的覆盖或非响应问题。
Identify coverage or non-response problems that weighting cannot repair.

title: 实验：把变化量与因果证据分开
Experiments: effect size is not the whole causal argument
explain: 随机分配让不同处理组在期望上可比；它不是保证一次实验中所有特征恰好相同。先确定随机化单位是用户、门店还是请求，再按同一单位解释结果。一个用户反复接触两组，可能破坏原本计划的比较。
Random assignment makes groups comparable in expectation, not identical in every realization. Define whether users, stores or requests are randomized and evaluate at that unit.
绝对变化以百分点表示，相对变化除以原水平。两者可以同时正确，但回答不同规模问题。观察到差异还要考虑抽样不确定性、观察期、漏斗口径和业务成本；一个算得出的提升不自动意味着应全面推广。
Percentage-point and relative changes describe different scales. Sampling uncertainty, follow-up, measurement and costs still matter before rollout.

title: 同一组数据的两种提升表达
Two descriptions of the same observed effect
given: 合成随机用户实验：A组1000人中100转化，B组1000人中130转化；固定观察7天，转化按不同用户计。
Synthetic randomized user experiment: A has 100/1000 conversions and B 130/1000, with seven-day follow-up and distinct users.

title: 先核对比较基础
Check comparability
detail: 确认两组都满7天、没有同用户跨组、转化定义相同，才能把1000与1000作为可比的分母。
Check equal follow-up, no cross-group users and identical conversion definitions before comparing denominators.

title: 计算绝对与相对差
Calculate both scales
detail: A=10%, B=13%; the difference is three percentage points and the relative increase 30%.

title: 区分观测与决策
Separate observation from action
detail: 先报告观察差异，再检查随机化、样本量和不确定性；结合每次转化收益与新增成本决定下一轮验证，不把30%写成所有未来人群的保证。
Report the observed difference, assess randomization and uncertainty, then compare benefits and costs; 30% is not a guaranteed future effect.

result: 正确表述是“本次样本中提高3个百分点，相对30%”，并说明适用人群、窗口与推广前待核证据。
Describe the observed three-point or 30% increase with population, window and remaining evidence.

wrong: 上线后一周比前一周高3个百分点，所以新按钮导致提升。
A three-point before/after increase proves the new button caused it.
why: 时间变化也可能带来流量来源、节假日或统计口径变化，没有随机对照不能排除这些解释。
Traffic mix, seasonality or measurement may also change without a randomized comparison.
correct: 用预先设计的可比对照和固定测量窗口，保留其他解释及不确定性。
Use a planned comparable control and fixed measurement window, retaining uncertainty.

prompt: 合成实验A=40/400、B=48/400。以下表述哪项算术正确？
Synthetic A=40/400 and B=48/400. Which effect description is arithmetically correct?

feedback: 10%到12%的绝对差应说2个百分点；相对变化是20%。
The absolute difference is two points and the relative increase 20%.
相对20%不能改写成20个百分点。
A 20% relative increase is not 20 percentage points.

text: 增加2个百分点，相对提升20%
Two percentage points, a 20% relative increase
feedback: The calculation is correct, but does not replace uncertainty analysis.

prompt: 随机实验C=30/300、D=39/300。写两种效应表达与两项推广前核查。
C=30/300 and D=39/300 in a randomized experiment. State both effects and two rollout checks.
sample: 10%到13%，增加3个百分点、相对30%；核对随机化单位和同观察窗，再评估不确定性、成本及失败风险。
The rate rises from 10% to 13%: three points or 30%. Check assignment, follow-up, uncertainty and costs.
criteria: 百分点与相对百分比没有混用。
Percentage points and relative percentage changes are distinct.
把样本观察、因果设计和推广条件分别说明。
Separate the observed effect, causal design and rollout conditions.

title: 事实表与维度：为何维表重复会放大金额
Facts and dimensions: how duplicate dimension keys inflate totals
explain: 事实表记录某一粒度的业务事件，如一行一笔订单明细；维度表提供产品类别等描述属性。度量值能否相加取决于粒度：明细金额通常可加，订单级运费若复制到每条明细就不能直接求和。
Facts record events at a declared grain; dimensions describe attributes. Additivity depends on that grain: line amounts can usually add, while repeated order-level shipping fees cannot.
维度连接应在所用版本范围内为每个事实键找到至多一个对应属性。若产品P1在维表出现两行，同一条P1事实可能被复制两次。历史维度还需要生效时间，不能把过去销售任意归到今天的类别。
Each fact should match at most one relevant dimension version. Duplicate product keys multiply facts; historical attributes require an effective-time rule.

title: 从交易明细得到类别销售额
From sales lines to category totals
given: 合成事实L1(P1,8)、L2(P1,12)、L3(P2,15)；产品维度P1=食品、P2=图书。目标是本批类别金额。
Synthetic facts: L1(P1,8), L2(P1,12), L3(P2,15). Dimension: P1=Food, P2=Books.

title: 声明两表粒度
Declare both grains
detail: 事实键为line_id，每条明细一行；维度键product_id在本批版本内唯一。连接前检查P1与P2各只有1个有效类别。
Facts use unique line_id; product_id is unique in the dimension version. Check one applicable category per product.

title: 逐行补充属性
Enrich each fact
detail: L1与L2各得到食品，L3得到图书；连接后仍3条明细，总额8+12+15=35。
L1/L2 map to Food and L3 to Books; three fact rows remain and total 35.

title: 汇总并反证重复
Aggregate and test duplication
detail: 食品20、图书15。若维表P1重复成两行，食品会变40、总额55；这正是应由键唯一性与金额对账拦截的错误。
Food=20, Books=15. Duplicating P1 would produce Food=40 and total 55, exposing the need for uniqueness and total reconciliation.

result: 类别合计35与事实原总额一致，连接没有改变明细覆盖与数量。
Category total 35 reconciles to the original facts without changing their coverage or count.

wrong: 维表重复后，只要按类别GROUP BY就能消除影响。
GROUP BY category removes the effect of duplicate dimension rows.
why: GROUP BY会把被复制的金额继续加起来，并不会知道哪些是错误复制。
Aggregation sums the duplicated values; it does not recognize their origin.
correct: 连接前验证维表适用键唯一，连接后复核事实键数与金额。
Check applicable dimension-key uniqueness before joining and reconcile fact counts afterward.

prompt: 事实P1=10、P2=20，维度P1重复两行、P2一行。直接连接金额总和是？
Facts are P1=10 and P2=20; P1 has two dimension matches and P2 one. What is the joined sum?

feedback: 连接按匹配行对输出，不按产品名称自动去重。
Joins output matching row pairs, not automatically deduplicated products.
P1金额10被计算两次，加P2的20得到40。
P1 contributes ten twice, plus P2’s 20.
只有P1有两次匹配，不能把P2也加倍。
Only P1 has two matches; P2 is not duplicated.

prompt: 两笔订单分别有2条和1条明细，订单级运费各6元。设计能正确算明细金额与运费的模型。
Two orders have two and one lines, each with six shipping units. Design correct line-amount and shipping totals.
sample: 明细金额按line_id汇总；运费保留在order_id粒度，或声明可对账的分摊规则。不能把三条明细上的6都相加得到18，订单运费合计应12。
Aggregate line amounts at line grain; keep shipping at order grain or use an explicit allocation. Shipping totals 12, not 18.
criteria: 事实与维度粒度、适用版本和键唯一条件明确。
Fact/dimension grain, applicable version and key uniqueness are explicit.
订单级与明细级度量分开对账。
Order- and line-level measures are reconciled separately.

title: 透视表：从字段布局到独立对账
Pivot tables: field placement and independent reconciliation
explain: 透视表把行列字段当作分组维度，把值字段按求和、计数或其他函数聚合。同一份数据用“金额求和”和“金额计数”会得到不同答案；把单元格显示成货币，并不会把文本金额自动变成可靠数值。
Pivot rows and columns define groups while the value field specifies aggregation. Amount sum differs from amount count; currency formatting does not establish numeric data.
透视结果还取决于源范围、筛选和刷新。新增记录在范围外，刷新也可能看不到；范围内有新记录但没刷新，也会保留旧结果。先确认这些条件，再用源表手算一组和总计，能定位问题出在输入还是聚合设置。
Source range, filters and refresh state also matter. An out-of-range row may remain absent after refresh, while an unrefreshed pivot can retain stale totals.

title: 为什么新交易没有进入总计
Why a new transaction is missing from the total
given: 合成交易：北区12、北区18、南区30；随后新增南区10。金额列为数值。要求按地区求销售金额。
Synthetic transactions: North 12 and 18, South 30; later add South 10. All amounts are numeric.

title: 安排字段
Place fields
detail: 地区放行字段，金额放值字段并选择求和。前三笔预期北30、南30、总60；若看到北2、南1，应检查是否用了计数。
Place Region in rows and Amount in values using Sum. The first three rows give 30/30/60; 2/1 indicates Count.

title: 扩展源并刷新
Include and refresh
detail: 确认新增南区10位于源表范围，再执行刷新。更新后北30、南40、总70；只改工作表里的可见值不等于重建透视结果。
Include the new row in the source and refresh. Expected totals become North 30, South 40, overall 70.

title: 独立核对
Reconcile independently
detail: 源表金额12+18+30+10=70，交易数4。分别核对计数与金额，确认筛选没有隐藏南区或把空白当作另一个地区。
Source amounts sum to 70 across four transactions. Check both count and money, along with filters and blank categories.

result: 正确透视为北30、南40、总70；字段、求和、源范围和刷新状态都有记录。
The correct pivot is North 30, South 40, total 70, with field and source settings recorded.

wrong: 透视总计显示4，就把格式设为货币并声称销售额4元。
Format a pivot total of four as currency and call it four units of sales.
why: 4很可能是交易计数；格式不能改变聚合函数，也不能纠正文本输入。
Four may be a transaction count. Formatting cannot change aggregation or repair input types.
correct: 打开值字段设置核对函数，再回源数据查类型和行数。
Inspect value-field aggregation and reconcile source types and row counts.

prompt: 金额5、15、20共三笔，透视显示3。最先应检查什么？
Three amounts 5,15,20 produce a pivot value of 3. What should be checked first?

text: Whether the value field uses Count
feedback: 3符合行数而非金额和40；先核对函数及源列类型。
Three matches row count, not the sum 40. Inspect aggregation and input type.
显示3.00仍然是计数3，无法变成销售金额40。
Displaying 3.00 does not turn a count into the sum 40.
没有证据说明交易错误，删数据会改变正确总额。
No error in the transactions has been established.

prompt: 东区8、东区12、西区5，新增西区15。写字段设置、刷新前后结果和源表对账。
East 8/12 and West 5 receive a new West 15. Record pivot settings, before/after totals and reconciliation.
sample: 行字段地区、值字段金额求和；刷新前东20西5总25，正确包含新增行后东20西20总40；源表4笔金额和40。
Region rows and Amount Sum; before 20/5/25, after 20/20/40, matching four source transactions.
criteria: 设置写明求和或计数及数据类型，而非只写“做透视”。
Specify aggregation and input type, not merely “make a pivot.”
源范围、筛选与刷新状态可复现，金额与笔数分别对账。
Range, filters and refresh are reproducible; money and counts reconcile separately.

title: 图表：让读者完成正确的比较
Charts: support the reader’s actual comparison
explain: 图形首先服务于一个比较任务：想比各地区大小，还是看同一指标随时间变化？类别金额适合用共享基线的条形图；时间序列则必须保留真实顺序与间隔。把地区按字母连接成折线，会暗示不存在的连续变化关系。

Choose the comparison before the chart. Bars support category magnitudes on a shared baseline; time series require chronological order and spacing. Connecting arbitrary categories suggests continuity that does not exist.
0表示测得为零，缺测表示没有可靠观测。给缺测月份补0，会制造一次暴跌和反弹；直接连接缺口也可能暗示中间变化已知。还应明确单位、时间范围和基线，让读者无需猜测柱长或线高代表什么。
Zero is an observed value; missing means unobserved. Replacing missing months with zero invents a collapse, while connecting gaps can imply an observed path. State units, period and baseline.

title: 同一简报里的类别图与趋势图
Separate category comparison from a time trend
given: 合成金额：同月地区A=50、B=30；季度金额Q1=20、Q2缺测、Q3=35。
Synthetic amounts: regions A=50 and B=30 in one month; quarterly values Q1=20, Q2 missing, Q3=35.

title: 先确定读者问题
Define the comparison
detail: 比较地区时，画A/B两根从0起的柱，单位一致；A比B多20。地区不是时间，不能把A到B解释成收入下降。
Use two zero-baseline bars for regions: A exceeds B by 20. Their order does not represent a temporal decline.

title: 如实编码缺测
Represent the gap
detail: 季度图保留Q1、Q2、Q3时间位置，Q2标缺测而不是0；可在Q2处断线，避免读者认为看到了完整轨迹。
Keep all quarter positions and mark Q2 missing, optionally breaking the line rather than filling zero.

title: 写出有限结论
State the supported claim
detail: 可说Q3观测35高于Q1的20，增加15；不能说每季度都增长，也不能由Q2缺测算出其增长率。
Q3 is 15 above Q1, but the data do not show growth in every quarter or a Q2 growth rate.

result: 类别大小与时间变化分开表达，缺测位置和比较范围可见。
Category magnitudes and temporal changes are separated, with missing observations visible.

wrong: 给Q2填0，让折线连续且更有冲击力。
Fill Q2 with zero for a dramatic continuous chart.
why: 这把没有观测变成确定的零，图形所讲的业务故事不再来自数据。
This changes absence of evidence into an asserted zero.
correct: 保留缺口和缺测说明，只对真实观测进行比较。
Retain the gap and compare only observed values.

prompt: 2月没有采集数据。以下哪个图例最诚实？
No data were collected in February. Which representation is most faithful?

feedback: 缺采集不能证明实际没有销售。
No collection does not establish no sales.
沿用上期也是一种插补假设，不能当成观测。
Carrying forward is an assumption, not an observation.

text: February missing, with its time position retained
feedback: 既保留时间结构，也不补造业务值。
This preserves chronology without inventing a value.

prompt: 3个月观测10、缺测、18；两类产品分别40和25。画两种草图并写标题、单位与缺测规则。
Monthly values are 10, missing,18; products total 40 and 25. Sketch both comparisons with titles, units and missing-data handling.
sample: 趋势图保留中月缺口；产品用同基线柱形图。标题说明月份/统计窗口和单位，不把产品差异称为时间增长。
Retain the time-series gap and use common-baseline bars for products. Titles state period and units.
criteria: 图形编码与比较任务吻合，轴、单位和基线明确。
Encoding matches the task, with explicit axes, units and baselines.
缺测没有变成0或未披露插补。
Missing values are not changed to zero or undisclosed imputations.

title: 分析简报：从观察到可检验的下一步
Analysis briefs: connect observations to a testable next step
explain: 观察是从数据直接复算的结果，解释是对原因的推断，建议是准备采取的行动。把它们混在一句“新流程使效率提升”中，会让读者不知道哪些已被证实。好的简报保留查询、窗口、样本和定义，让其他人能重新得到观察值。

Observation is reproducible from data; explanation proposes a cause; recommendation proposes action. A brief should make these roles visible and retain enough input and definitions to reproduce the observation.
限制不是结尾的通用免责声明，而是会改变决策的一条具体证据缺口。例如配送距离变短，可能解释平均耗时下降。下一步应直接针对这个缺口，如固定距离分组比较，而不是只写“继续关注”。
A useful limitation identifies a gap that can change the decision. If shorter distances explain faster deliveries, the next step should compare distance-matched groups rather than vaguely monitor.

title: 将“效率提升”拆成四段证据
Unpack an apparent efficiency improvement
given: 合成周报：配送中位数从9降到7分钟，同时3公里内订单占比从30%增到70%；尚无按距离分组结果。
Synthetic weekly report: median delivery time falls from nine to seven minutes while short-distance orders rise from 30% to 70%. No distance-stratified results exist.

title: 写可复算观察
Write the observation
detail: 本周中位数7分钟，比上周低2分钟；同时记录两周订单范围、样本量和时长定义。这里没有使用“导致”一词。
State the two-minute decline with periods, population and duration definition, without claiming causation.

title: 提出竞争解释
Identify an alternative
detail: 近距离订单增加可能让总体中位数下降，即使每个距离组的配送效率都没变化。先将“流程改善”列为待验证解释。
A larger short-distance share can lower the overall median even if performance within every distance band is unchanged.

title: 给出能改变判断的行动
Design a decision-changing check
detail: 下一步固定距离段和相同观察窗，比较各段耗时及订单占比；保留查询与分组表。若各段也持续改善，再讨论流程收益与推广成本。
Compare duration within fixed distance bands and windows, retaining queries and counts before discussing rollout benefits.

result: 简报分开列观察、备选原因、缺失证据和下一步验收，而不是把相关变化写成因果事实。
The brief separates observation, alternative explanations, missing evidence and acceptance of the next check.

wrong: 因为9降到7，就写“流程优化使时效提升22.2%”。
Call the observed decline a 22.2% improvement caused by process optimization.
why: 相对下降可算，但因果归属没有控制订单构成变化；数字精确不使解释成立。
The relative change is calculable, but the causal attribution ignores changing composition.
correct: 写明下降约22.2%是总体观察，按距离进一步复核后再给因果判断。
Label the relative decline as an overall observation and investigate within distance bands.

prompt: 退款率由8%到10%，但新版规则扩大了退款订单定义。首先如何写简报？
Refund rate rises from 8% to 10% after the definition expands. What should the brief do first?

text: 说明口径变化并按同口径复算
Disclose the definition change and recompute comparably
feedback: 先确认可比性，才能判断变化多少来自实际业务。
Establish comparability before interpreting business change.

text: 直接责备客服服务变差
Attribute the rise to worse service
feedback: 尚未排除统计定义变化，也没有服务质量的因果证据。
The measurement change has not been ruled out.
改写结果不是校正口径，会丢失真实数据及规则差异。
Changing the number is not a reproducible definition adjustment.

prompt: 本月处理总量增加20%，同期员工增加25%。写一段观察、限制和可检验建议。
Work volume rises 20% while staffing rises 25%. Write an observation, limitation and testable recommendation.
sample: 总量增加20%是观察，不足以说明人均效率上升。比较相同任务难度下的人均或每工时产出、质量及处理时长，再决定排班建议。
Higher total volume does not establish higher per-person productivity. Compare like-for-like output per work hour, quality and duration.
criteria: 观察能复算，原因推断与建议不冒充已证实事实。
Observations are reproducible and separated from causal claims.
下一步有具体数据、比较口径和验收结果，不只是“关注”。
The next step names data, comparable scope and a decision-relevant result.

title: 事实粒度与键：一行究竟代表什么
Grain and keys: what one row actually represents
explain: 粒度用业务语言定义一行，而不是只写表名。一行一笔订单与一行一件商品都可能有order_id，但后者不是订单唯一键。用错粒度会把订单级运费、余额或状态复制成多份，导致后续汇总在没有报错的情况下失真。

Grain defines one row in business terms. Both orders and lines contain order_id, but it is not unique for lines. Mixing grains duplicates order-level amounts without necessarily causing a database error.
键是对粒度约定的检验。明细可以用line_id或(order_id,line_no)，订单表用order_id。度量能否相加也依赖粒度与时间：同一账户不同日期余额是快照，不能相加当成收入；订单金额与明细金额应各有对账集合。
A key tests the grain contract. Lines may use line_id or a composite key; orders use order_id. Additivity also depends on time: repeated account balances are snapshots, not new income.

title: 三条明细里只有两笔订单运费
Three lines contain only two shipping fees
given: 合成订单A含两明细10、15元，运费5元；B含一明细20元，运费5元。要求商品金额与订单运费合计。
Synthetic A has lines 10/15 and shipping 5; B has one line 20 and shipping 5.

title: 明确业务键
Name the business keys
detail: 明细键A/1、A/2、B/1共3个；订单键A、B共2个。两种记录不应被当作同一种事实。
There are three line keys and two order keys; they represent different facts.

title: 按原粒度计算
Calculate at native grain
detail: 商品金额10+15+20=45；运费按订单A5+B5=10。若在三行明细里复制5再求和，会得到错误运费15。
Line revenue is 45; order shipping is 10. Repeating shipping on each line would incorrectly produce 15.

title: 输出可对账模型
Make the model reconcilable
detail: 明细表保留line_id及商品金额，订单表保留order_id及运费；若需分摊，A的5元可按明确规则分成两份，且合计仍为5。
Keep line amounts and order shipping at their own grains, or allocate with a declared rule that reconciles A back to 5.

result: 本批商品45、运费10，明细数3、订单数2；粒度和键都能从输入验证。
Goods 45, shipping 10, three lines and two orders are independently verifiable.

wrong: 有order_id字段就把明细表声明为一行一单。
Call a line table one-row-per-order because it has order_id.
why: 字段存在不保证唯一；A已有两行，直接违反这一声明。
A already has two rows, disproving uniqueness.
correct: 先写粒度，再用唯一性、行数与实体覆盖验证键。
Declare grain and validate uniqueness, row counts and entity coverage.

prompt: 账户X周一余额100、周二余额120。两行余额相加220可以叫两天收入吗？
Account X has balances 100 Monday and 120 Tuesday. Is 220 two-day income?

feedback: 余额是时点快照，不是两次新增流入。
Balances are snapshots, not two new inflows.

text: 不可以；也不能仅凭差额20断定收入
No; even the change 20 is not necessarily income
feedback: 变化还可能含支出、转账或调整，需要交易流量支持。
The change can include spending, transfers or adjustments.
差额是净余额变化，不能分解出收入总额。
A net balance change does not identify gross income.

prompt: 订单C两明细合计30、运费6；D三明细合计50、运费8。设计两表键并列正确总计。
C has two lines totaling 30 and shipping 6; D has three lines totaling 50 and shipping 8. Model keys and totals.
sample: 明细表5个line键，订单表2个order键；商品80、运费14。运费若分摊到明细，分组回订单后须分别仍为6与8。
Five line keys, two order keys; goods 80 and shipping 14. Any allocation must reconcile back to 6 and 8.
criteria: 每表一行的业务含义和唯一键明确。
Each table has an explicit business grain and unique key.
不同粒度和快照度量没有被无条件混加。
Different grains and snapshot measures are not indiscriminately added.

title: SQL转换：用中间对账定位丢失和放大
SQL transformations: reconcile intermediate stages
explain: 过滤、连接、派生和聚合都会改变结果。最终总额不一致时，仅盯着最后一条SQL很难知道是哪一步出错。把转换拆成命名清楚的中间结果，记录每步允许发生的行数和金额变化，就能从第一个偏离预期的位置开始调查。
Filtering, joins, derivation and grouping can each change output. Named intermediate results and expected count/amount changes localize the first divergence.
对账不是要求每一步总额都相等。取消单按定义被排除是合理变化，但应知道哪些ID贡献了差额；连接后的意外重复则不合理。整数分值、币种和舍入规则也应固定，否则金额差异可能来自类型或单位。

Reconciliation does not require every stage to preserve totals. Declared exclusions are legitimate when their IDs explain the difference; accidental join multiplication is not. Fix units and rounding too.

title: 先找到第一次偏离的转换
Find the first incorrect transformation
given: 合成同日订单A已付10、B已付20、C取消30；次日D已付40。目标为同日已付销售额，关联维表后结果意外为50。
Synthetic same-day orders A paid 10, B paid 20, C cancelled 30; next-day D paid 40. Target same-day paid sales, but a dimension join gives 50.

title: 冻结输入范围
Freeze the input scope
detail: 按同日窗口先保留A、B、C，总额60；D不属于此窗口，不能为了对上总数而加入。
The day’s input is A/B/C totaling 60. D is outside the window.

title: 对账业务排除
Reconcile the business filter
detail: 排除取消C后，剩A10+B20=30、2个不同订单。差额30可由C的ID和状态完整解释。
Removing C leaves two orders totaling 30; C’s ID and state explain the exclusion.

title: 定位连接放大
Locate join inflation
detail: 若关联后成50，按订单计匹配数发现B匹配2行：A10+B20+B20。修正维度唯一性后回到30，而不是再过滤某个金额。
A joined total 50 can arise from B matching twice. Fix the dimension match rather than filtering an arbitrary amount.

result: 每步保留输入版本、窗口、ID覆盖、计数和金额，最终30可追溯到两笔订单。
Retain version, window, ID coverage, counts and totals at each stage; final 30 traces to two orders.

wrong: 发现最终多20，就在SQL末尾减去20。
Subtract 20 from the final query result.
why: 这只修饰当前样例，重复键仍存在，换一批数据就会再次出错。
This disguises one example without repairing the duplicate match.
correct: 比较各阶段的允许变化，修复导致偏差的转换规则。
Reconcile allowed changes and repair the responsible transformation.

prompt: 过滤前总额200，按已记录取消单排除50，连接后得到180。该优先查哪一步？
Input 200 minus declared cancellations 50 becomes 180 after joining. Which stage needs investigation?

text: 取消过滤，因为必须总额不变
The filter, since totals must never change
feedback: 排除50已有业务依据，预期中间值应150。
The exclusion is justified;150 is the expected intermediate total.
正确目标不代表可以跳过根因修复。
Knowing the target does not justify hiding the cause.

text: 连接阶段，检查额外30对应的匹配键
The join, tracing keys that add 30
feedback: 从150变180的阶段首次偏离，应按键核对匹配数。
The first unexplained change is 150 to 180; inspect matches by key.

prompt: 输入已付8、已付12、取消5；转换需按日已付金额。写每步期望与两个故障检查。
Input has paid 8, paid 12 and cancelled 5. Specify daily transformation checkpoints and two fault checks.
sample: 输入3行总25；过滤后2行总20；维度连接不应增加不同订单数或金额；聚合日总20。查重复维键与日期边界，不用常数补差。
Input 3/25, filtered 2/20, join preserves entities and amount, daily total 20. Check dimension duplicates and date boundaries.
criteria: 中间对账能指出首个异常阶段与具体键。
Intermediate reconciliation locates the first faulty stage and keys.
合理排除与错误丢失/放大有不同解释，不用常数修饰。
Legitimate exclusions are distinguished from erroneous loss or inflation.

title: 分区与演进：改变布局不等于改写历史
Partition evolution does not rewrite history
explain: 分区是组织和裁剪物理数据的办法，不是业务唯一键。按天分区有助于少扫无关日期，但不能保证同一天内订单不重复。业务字段改名或新增还涉及模式兼容，必须分开理解逻辑字段和物理存储布局。
Partitions organize physical data and prune scans; they are not business keys. Daily partitioning does not prevent duplicates. Schema compatibility and physical layout are separate concerns.
支持分区演进的表格式可以让不同文件使用不同规格。以Iceberg为例，改成日分区主要影响后续写入，旧文件不会仅因配置改变就自动重排；读者需要识别各文件适用的规格。不能把这种能力泛化为任何CSV目录都具备。

Formats supporting partition evolution can retain files under multiple specifications. In Iceberg, changing to daily partitioning does not automatically rewrite old files; readers interpret each specification. A CSV directory has no such automatic guarantee.

title: 读一周数据时面对两种分区规格
Read one week across two partition specifications
given: 合成表：1月旧文件按月分区，2月新文件按日分区。查询1月29日至2月3日（含），使用支持该表演进规格的读引擎。
Synthetic table: January files are monthly, February files daily. Query Jan 29–Feb 3 inclusive with a reader that supports the table’s specifications.

title: 识别文件与规格
Identify specifications
detail: 1月文件标旧月规格，2月文件标新日规格；不能只按新目录命名去找1月29日文件，否则会漏旧数据。
January files use the old monthly spec and February files the new daily spec; looking only for daily paths loses old data.

title: 裁剪后仍做行过滤
Filter after pruning
detail: 旧月文件可能包含整个1月，需要读取相关文件后按日期保留29–31日；新规格可先选2月1–3日。分区裁剪不是最终业务过滤的替代。
Read relevant January files then filter rows to 29–31; prune February to 1–3. Pruning does not replace row predicates.

title: 核对覆盖与兼容
Reconcile coverage
detail: 对照原逻辑日期集合确认6天全覆盖且无重复；核旧读者能否理解新规格。若要重排旧文件，另做可回退的重写操作。
Reconcile all six days without duplication and check reader compatibility. Historical file rewriting is a separate controlled operation.

result: 逻辑查询结果应跨新旧规格一致；布局演进与历史重写分别记录。
Logical results remain consistent across specifications; evolution and rewriting are tracked separately.

wrong: 改成日分区后，立刻删除旧月分区，因为它们已经过期。
Delete monthly files immediately after switching to daily partitioning.
why: 旧文件仍可能承载有效历史记录；删除会造成真实数据丢失。
Those files may still contain valid historical records.
correct: 先核每个文件的有效性、规格和引用，再按存储格式支持的维护流程处理。
Check file validity, specification and references before format-supported maintenance.

prompt: 新规格只用于新写文件。哪项结论成立？
A new specification applies to newly written files. Which conclusion follows?

text: 旧文件可能继续使用旧规格，读者必须兼容
Old files may retain the old spec; readers must support it
feedback: 新旧共存是应核对的读取条件，不是历史已重写的证明。
Coexistence is a reader requirement, not evidence of a rewrite.

text: 旧文件内容已经自动改成新格式
feedback: 规格更新没有说明发生了文件重写。
A specification change does not establish a file rewrite.

text: 分区列天然就是订单唯一键
feedback: 物理分组无法代替业务实体唯一性。
Physical grouping does not establish entity uniqueness.

prompt: 按月旧数据与按日新数据并存，需新增可空字段region。列兼容核查和查询对账。
Monthly and daily layouts coexist; add nullable region. Define compatibility and result checks.
sample: 核字段ID/类型及旧读者行为；旧记录region缺值需有明确含义。跨规格读固定日期窗口，对账键数、金额和空值，不声称旧文件已重排。
Check field identity, type and readers; define missing region for older rows. Reconcile keys, amounts and nulls across layouts.
criteria: 分区、主键、模式演进和文件重写分开解释。
Partitions, business keys, schema changes and rewrites are distinct.
新旧布局/字段均有读写兼容与结果覆盖核查。
Both old and new layouts have compatibility and coverage checks.

title: 数据窗口：任务今天跑，不代表处理今天
Data intervals are independent of wall-clock run time
explain: 执行时间描述作业什么时候运行，逻辑窗口描述它负责哪段数据。迟到重跑不应让查询范围跟着“现在”漂移，否则昨天失败的任务今天重跑会算到另一批数据。把窗口作为输入参数，才能说明一次运行的职责。
Execution time says when a job runs; the data interval says what it owns. A delayed retry must not shift its query to a different period based on now.
半开区间[start,end)包含起点、不包含终点，让相邻窗口无缝衔接而不重复边界。调度工具如何给出窗口取决于版本和timetable；不要只看到每天02:00触发，就推断一定处理昨天全天。手动触发也应明确窗口。
Half-open intervals include start and exclude end, avoiding overlapping boundaries. Scheduler intervals depend on timetable and version, not merely the displayed trigger time.

title: 延迟两天仍只处理同一个逻辑日
A delayed run keeps the same logical day
given: 合成任务参数start=11月3日00:00，end=11月4日00:00；11月5日才执行。记录X在3日23:59，Y在4日00:00。
Synthetic parameters: Nov 3 00:00 to Nov 4 00:00, executed Nov 5. X occurs Nov 3 23:59 and Y Nov 4 00:00.

title: 读窗口参数
Read interval parameters
detail: 本次职责是[start,end)，不是11月5日。运行清单保存时区及两个边界，查询不得用NOW()-1day替代。
The owned interval is fixed, not Nov 5. Record timezone and bounds; do not replace them with now-minus-one-day.

title: 判断边界记录
Classify boundary records
detail: X满足event_time>=start且<end，属于本次；Y等于end，归下一个窗口。这样两次相邻运行不会都处理Y。
X belongs to this interval; Y equals the excluded end and belongs to the next one.

title: 复跑保持输入身份
Keep identity on retry
detail: 11月6日再跑时仍用同一边界与输入版本；比较产物键集合与校验值，确认重复运行没有换数据。
A Nov 6 retry uses the same interval and input version, then reconciles keys and checksums.

result: X在本次、Y在下次；执行日期改变不改变这份窗口合同。
X belongs here and Y to the next interval; execution dates do not change the contract.

wrong: 失败重跑时总用当前日期减一天。
Always query yesterday relative to the retry date.
why: 重跑会悄悄处理新窗口，原缺失窗口可能永远没有补齐。
The retry processes a new interval and may leave the original gap unresolved.
correct: 冻结逻辑窗口、时区和输入版本，运行日期仅作执行元数据。
Freeze interval, timezone and input version; treat run date as metadata.

prompt: 窗口[09:00,10:00)里，哪个事件属于本次？
Which event belongs to [09:00,10:00)?

feedback: 终点不包含，属于下一个相邻窗口。
The endpoint is excluded and belongs to the next interval.
起点包含；明确时区后可无歧义分类。
The start is included, with timezone specified.
到达日期不是这里约定的事件时间边界。
Arrival date is not the declared event-time boundary.

prompt: 任务周三补跑周一数据，源中有周日23:59、周一00:00、周二00:00三条。写窗口与归属。
A Wednesday run backfills Monday. Inputs occur Sunday 23:59, Monday 00:00 and Tuesday 00:00. State interval membership.
sample: 以声明时区的[周一00:00,周二00:00)为窗口，只包含周一00:00。保留补跑日期但不让它改筛选条件。
Use Monday 00:00 inclusive to Tuesday 00:00 exclusive; only Monday 00:00 belongs. The Wednesday run date does not change filtering.
criteria: 窗口、时区、边界开闭和调度来源明确。
Interval, timezone, boundary convention and scheduling source are explicit.
重跑能回到同一输入集合，相邻窗口不重复计边界事件。
Retries use the same input scope and adjacent intervals do not double-count endpoints.

title: 幂等批次：失败重跑后仍是一份结果
Idempotent batches: one logical result after retries
explain: 幂等说的是重复处理相同逻辑输入后，外部可见结果等价，不是日志里出现一次“成功”。追加写入往往会重复记录；稳定键合并或固定分区替换可以避免这种累加，但还要考虑失败发生在写入中途时读者看到了什么。

Idempotency concerns the visible result of repeated identical input, not a success log. Append-only retries can duplicate records; keyed merge or partition replacement also needs a failure-visibility policy.
把计算结果先写到隔离暂存区并校验，再利用目标存储支持的事务或原子元数据切换发布，可以避免读者看到半批新结果。原子性依具体存储能力验证，不能把任意云目录改名都当作数据库事务。
Stage and validate output before using a supported transaction or atomic metadata switch. Atomicity is storage-specific; arbitrary directory operations are not automatically database transactions.

title: 写到第8行失败时读者应看到什么
What readers see when a write fails at row eight
given: 合成逻辑窗口W预期20个唯一ID，总金额200。第一次写暂存到第8行失败；目标还保留旧完整批次。
Synthetic window W contains 20 unique IDs totaling 200. The first staged write fails at row eight while the old complete target remains.

title: 冻结批次身份
Freeze the batch identity
detail: W、输入版本与20个ID集合固定；重跑读取同一输入，不使用持续变化的latest路径。
Freeze W, input version and the 20 IDs; retries do not read a changing latest path.

title: 隔离未完成写入
Isolate incomplete output
detail: 失败的8行只在暂存区，不对下游标记已发布；重跑可清理该暂存版本或覆盖同一批次，避免把8再追加到20中。
The eight partial rows are unpublished. Retry replaces or clears staging rather than appending them to the new 20.

title: 校验后发布
Validate then publish
detail: 暂存20行、ID唯一、金额200后，按已验证的事务/切换方式发布。再次重跑后可见仍20行、金额200，旧版本保留到确认可回退。
Publish only after count, uniqueness and amount checks; another retry still exposes 20/200, with rollback available.

result: 失败时可见旧完整批次，成功后可见新完整批次；相同输入重复执行不变成28或40行。
Readers see a complete old or new batch; retries do not produce 28 or 40 rows.

wrong: 第一次部分写入后直接append完整20行。
Append the full 20 rows after the partial failure.
why: 会残留8条重复贡献，进程成功也不能证明结果正确。
Eight duplicated contributions can remain despite successful execution.
correct: 固定批次、隔离暂存、核对后提交，并对重复运行做结果断言。
Freeze the batch, stage privately, validate and assert retry equivalence.

prompt: 一个10行固定批次被重跑两次。哪个结果能支持幂等？
A fixed 10-row batch runs twice. Which result supports idempotency?

feedback: 日志只证明程序路径，没有核对可见数据是否重复。
Logs alone do not establish the visible result.
相同实体累计两份，直接违反本题结果约定。
The same entities have accumulated twice.

text: 结果仍10个ID且内容/金额一致
Still 10 IDs with equal content and totals
feedback: 键集合和业务结果相同，才对准幂等的外部效果。
Equivalent keys and business values test the visible effect.

prompt: 固定分区有12行总额90，写入失败且提交状态不明。写恢复判断与复跑验收。
A12-row partition totaling 90 fails with uncertain commit status. Design recovery and retry acceptance.
sample: 先查批次回执与目标版本；若已提交不重复追加，未提交则重建暂存后校验12行/90再发布。验证目标支持的提交语义与回退。
Inspect receipt and target version first; avoid reappending a committed batch. Otherwise rebuild and validate 12/90 before supported publication.
criteria: 输入身份固定，重跑前先确定提交状态。
Input identity is fixed and uncertain commit state is reconciled first.
部分数据不冒充发布完成，结果级检查覆盖重复运行。
Partial data are not called published and retries are checked at result level.

title: 补数：修的是数据窗口与依赖，不是一个按钮
Backfills repair intervals and their dependencies
explain: 补数是在已过去的逻辑窗口中补入缺失或更正数据。只让上游某天重新成功还不够：下游累计、滚动窗口和已发布报表可能仍保留旧结果。范围要由数据依赖决定，而不是只按今天日期或失败任务名称猜。
A backfill repairs historical intervals. Upstream success alone does not update downstream cumulative or rolling results; dependency semantics determine scope.
补数要冻结输入版本与规则，并控制资源和发布顺序。上游验证完成后再重算受影响下游，记录旧/新版本和差额；如果历史规则也变了，就不能把重算差异全部称为“补齐漏数”。
Freeze data and transformation versions, control concurrency and validate upstream before downstream publication. Separate missing-data repair from rule changes.

title: 一天更正为什么影响三天滚动值
One correction affects three rolling windows
given: 合成日金额1日10、2日20、3日30、4日40。三日滚动和含当天；1日金额应更正为15。
Synthetic daily amounts: day 1=10, day 2=20, day 3=30, day 4=40. A three-day sum includes the current day; day 1 becomes 15.

title: 列影响窗口
List affected windows
detail: 1日进入以1、2、3日为终点的滚动窗口；不进入4日窗口[2,3,4]。因此不是只改1日，也不必无条件重算所有未来日期。
Day 1 contributes to windows ending days 1,2,3, but not day 4’s [2,3,4] window.

title: 先改上游事实
Repair upstream facts
detail: 在固定规则下将1日从10改为15，核对差额+5及更正来源，再运行受影响的滚动作业。
Validate the source-backed+5 correction before recomputing dependent windows.

title: 发布下游更正
Publish downstream revisions
detail: 3日三日和由60变65；4日仍90。给下游新版本、受影响日期和差额，不静默覆盖一份已引用的报表。
The day 3 sum changes 60→65, while day 4 remains 90. Notify downstream with versions, affected dates and differences.

result: 补数清单同时包含上游窗口与依赖结果，并能解释哪些日期改变、哪些不变。
The plan names both repaired source intervals and affected downstream results.

wrong: 上游补跑成功，就立即宣布所有历史报表已恢复。
Declare all historical reports repaired when the upstream retry succeeds.
why: 下游可能没有自动失效或重算，仍在读旧版本。
Downstream jobs may still read old versions.
correct: 按依赖图追踪受影响结果，逐层对账后再发布恢复状态。
Trace dependencies and reconcile each affected layer before declaring recovery.

prompt: 两日滚动和包含当天及前一天；2日由5改为8。哪些终点日需要重算？
A two-day rolling sum includes today and yesterday. Day 2 changes 5→8. Which ending days are affected?

feedback: 这两个窗口含2日；4日窗口只含3和4日。
Both windows contain day 2; day 4 does not.
忽略了3日结果仍引用更正前的2日数据。
Day 3 still depends on the corrected day 2.

text: 所有未来日都必然改变
feedback: 有限滚动窗口不会无限依赖2日，需按定义划范围。
A finite rolling window does not depend on day 2 indefinitely.

prompt: 7日数据晚到，会影响当日汇总与7日移动平均。写补数顺序、日期范围和发布核查。
Late day 7 data affect daily totals and a seven-day moving average. Plan order, scope and release checks.
sample: 先验7日原始输入与日汇总，再重算终点7至13日的受影响移动窗口；边界按实际保留期确认，记录差额、版本与下游通知。
Validate day 7 raw/daily data, then windows ending 7–13 within supported retention. Record differences, versions and notifications.
criteria: 范围来自指标窗口和依赖，而非执行日期猜测。
Scope follows window semantics and dependencies.
上游、下游与发布状态均有独立对账与回退安排。
Upstream, downstream and publication have separate reconciliation and rollback plans.

title: 事件时间：迟到不是发生得晚
Event time: late arrival is not late occurrence
explain: 事件时间表示业务实际发生的时刻，处理时间表示系统何时看到它。手机离线后补传的付款，可能在10点发生、10点20才到达。按到达时刻改写发生时间，会把真实业务归到错误窗口。
Event time records occurrence; processing time records observation by the system. An offline payment may occur at 10:00 and arrive at 10:20. Changing its timestamp changes the business fact.
水位线是系统对事件时间进度的估计，不是绝对保证再也没有更早事件。窗口何时输出、迟到数据能否更正、多久后停止接受，要由明确策略决定。不能只凭“有水位线”就声称数据完整或结果永不变化。
A watermark estimates event-time progress rather than proving all earlier events have arrived. Output timing, allowed lateness and correction policy determine the result’s lifecycle.

title: 同一五分钟窗口里的两次晚到
Two late arrivals for one five-minute window
given: 合成窗口[10:00,10:05)，允许迟到到10:10（不含10:10）；事件A发生10:02、到达10:07，B发生10:03、到达10:12。本例明确采用按此到达截止更正的教学策略。
Synthetic window[10:00,10:05), with an explicit teaching correction deadline before 10:10. A occurs 10:02/arrives 10:07; B occurs 10:03/arrives 10:12.

title: 先按发生时间归窗
Assign by occurrence
detail: A和B都发生在同一窗口，不能因为到达时刻不同就分到10:05或10:10窗口。
Both belong to the original event-time window, regardless of arrival.

title: 应用明确迟到规则
Apply the declared policy
detail: A在截止前，可更新原窗口并产生新版结果；B超过截止，本例进入迟到侧输出与人工补数队列，而非静默消失。
A can revise the window; B goes to a late-data/backfill queue under this declared policy.

title: 标清结果版本
Version revised output
detail: 初次结果与A更正后结果分别记录版本及增量；B仍保留原时间和去向，不能说当前窗口已含全部事件。
Version the original and revised output, retaining B’s timestamp and disposition rather than claiming completeness.

result: 事件归属与接收策略分开；迟到会影响结果版本，但不改写发生事实。
Window membership and acceptance policy are distinct; lateness changes revisions, not occurrence.

wrong: 为避免处理迟到，把A时间改成10:07。
Change A’s event time to 10:07 to avoid late handling.
why: 这把传输延迟伪装成业务发生时间，统计窗口与下游解释都被改变。
This disguises transmission delay as occurrence and changes business statistics.
correct: 保留两个时间，明确接受、侧输出和补数策略。
Preserve both times with explicit acceptance, side-output and repair rules.

prompt: 事件10:04发生，10:09到达；按事件时间的[10:00,10:05)窗口应如何归属？
An event occurs 10:04 and arrives 10:09. Which event-time window owns it?

feedback: 这是按处理时间归窗，不符合题目声明。
That uses processing time, contrary to the question.
发生时间决定归属，是否接收是另一条规则。
Occurrence determines membership; acceptance is a separate rule.
没有给出删除策略；迟到本身不等于应丢弃。
No discard policy was specified.

prompt: 两个事件同在11:00前发生，一个准时、一个晚15分钟到达。设计临时结果、更正和补数记录。
Two events occur before 11:00, one arrives on time and one 15 minutes late. Design provisional, correction and backfill records.
sample: 保留event_time/received_at；写清窗口、截止、水位线含义与超时去向。晚到若超自动更正期则登记补数，通知消费者当前结果的完整性限制。
Retain both times, window, deadline and late disposition; route expired corrections to backfill with consumer-visible completeness limits.
criteria: 发生时间与到达时间没有混用。
Occurrence and arrival are not conflated.
接受/侧输出/补数及结果版本由明确策略控制。
Acceptance, side output, backfill and revisions follow an explicit policy.

title: 重复事件：去重记忆也有边界
Deduplication has an identity and retention boundary
explain: 事件ID表示一次业务事件，客户ID通常表示很多事件属于同一个人。按客户去重会误删合法多次付款；按稳定event_id去重才能识别重传。相同ID但内容不同是冲突，需要调查而不是随意留第一次。
Event IDs identify occurrences; customer IDs identify people who can have many valid events. Deduplicate retransmissions by stable event identity and investigate same-ID content conflicts.
去重状态只保留一天，就无法仅靠该状态识别两天后重放的旧事件。消费位点恢复、目标写入和去重保留期必须一起设计。所谓“重放安全”需要说明范围，不能把有限记忆说成永久不重复。
A one-day state store cannot by itself recognize a duplicate replayed two days later. Offset recovery, sink behavior and retention jointly determine replay safety.

title: 同ID重传与同客户新付款
Retransmission versus another payment by the same customer
given: 合成事件e1客户C金额10、e2客户C金额20、再次e1金额10，都在本例保留窗口内。
Synthetic events: e1(customer C,10), e2(C,20), then e1(C,10), all within retained deduplication state.

title: 选择正确身份
Choose event identity
detail: e1与e2是两次付款，客户相同不应折叠。只有第二次e1与已见e1的业务内容相同，符合重传判定。
e1 and e2 are separate payments; only the repeated identical e1 is a retransmission.

title: 更新受控状态与结果
Update state and result
detail: 处理e1后总10，e2后总30，重复e1后仍30；去重日志记重复次数与原事件ID。
The total evolves 10→30→30, with the duplicate linked to e1.

title: 测试越界重放和冲突
Test expiry and conflicts
detail: 若e1状态已过期，再收到它时不能保证仅靠该层拒重；应通过目标唯一键/受控重算等策略防重。若e1变12，另记冲突。
After expiry, this layer alone cannot guarantee deduplication. Use sink identity or controlled rebuilding; changed e1 content is a conflict.

result: 本窗口总额30，合法的同客户多次付款保留；永久重放安全不由这一个测试证明。
The retained-window total is 30; valid repeated-customer payments remain. This does not prove permanent replay safety.

wrong: 按customer_id只留一条，避免重复付款。
Keep one record per customer to avoid duplicate payments.
why: 会把同客户真实发生的e2误删，去重变成了丢业务事件。
This drops the legitimate e2 payment.
correct: 以业务事件ID和内容一致性识别重复，明确状态保留与过期恢复。
Use event IDs and consistent payloads with a declared retention/recovery policy.

prompt: 状态保留24小时，48小时后重放相同ID。哪项说法可靠？
Dedup state lasts 24 hours; an identical ID replays after 48. Which statement is justified?

text: The original state must recognize it
feedback: 24小时状态可能已经清理，无法保证。
The retained state may already be gone.

text: 可以改成新ID后直接入账
Assign a new ID and count it
feedback: 这会绕过去重，把同一事件当成新业务。
A new ID disguises the same event as new business.

text: 需要目标键或其他恢复策略，原状态不足以保证
Sink identity or another recovery strategy is needed
feedback: 保留期限定了该去重层能够提供的保证。
Retention limits this layer’s guarantee.

prompt: 事件p1=5、p2=7、p1=5、p2=9。写接受、重复与冲突清单和金额发布规则。
Events are p1=5,p2=7,p1=5,p2=9. Classify accepted, duplicate and conflict records.
sample: p1第二次为重复；p2的7与9冲突，不把9默认为更新。保留原ID/内容，冻结或标注受影响金额，查明更正规则再发布。
The second p1 is duplicate; p2’s7/9 conflict. Preserve both and resolve authority before publishing a definitive affected total.
criteria: 事件身份、合法多事件与内容冲突明确区分。
Event identity, legitimate multiple events and payload conflicts are distinct.
保留期和超期重放行为可解释，不声称无限去重。
Retention and expired-replay behavior are explicit.

title: 增量对账：新增、修改、删除分别处理
Incremental validation: distinguish inserts, updates and deletes
explain: 增量不是“只把新行加上”。源数据还可能修改旧值、删除实体或迟到进入旧窗口。验证时，应拿相同输入截止、规则与业务窗口的全量结果对照，否则比较差异可能只是两边看到了不同版本。
Incremental processing includes updates, deletes and late arrivals, not only appended rows. Reconcile against a full result with the same cutoff, rules and window.
总额一致也不代表实体正确：一笔漏算10与另一笔多算10会相互抵消。对账应包含键集合、每键值、计数和总量；发现差异后再沿到达时间与处理状态定位原因。
Equal totals can hide offsetting errors. Compare key sets, per-key values, counts and totals, then trace arrival and processing state.

title: 一轮新增、修改和删除的结果
One round of insert, update and delete
given: 合成旧目标A=10、B=20、C=30；本轮新增D=40，修改B为25，删除A。源在固定截止后的完整状态为B25、C30、D40。
Old target A10,B20,C30. Delta inserts D40, updates B25 and deletes A. Full state at the fixed cutoff is B25,C30,D40.

title: 分类变更
Classify changes
detail: 新增带来+40，修改B带来+5，删除A带来-10；不能把B25作为另一条新增金额。
Insert+40, update+5 and delete-10 are distinct; B25 is not another appended record.

title: 计算期望结果
Compute the expected state
detail: Total 60+40+5-10=95; keys become {B,C,D}, still three entities.

title: 逐键对全量
Reconcile per key
detail: 对照全量B25/C30/D40，检查A确已移除。若总95但键值不同，仍判不一致，并保留差异ID而不是只报“总额对上”。
Compare all key/value pairs and confirm A is absent. Matching 95 alone is insufficient.

result: 正确增量结果3个键、总95，并与同版本全量逐键一致。
The correct result has three keys and total 95, matching the same-version full state per key.

wrong: 只比较总额，差异为0就发布。
Publish whenever total difference is zero.
why: 相互抵消的漏算与多算会被掩盖，后续按实体查询仍可能错。
Offsetting omissions and duplicates can leave entity results wrong.
correct: 增加键差、每键值差及删除覆盖检查，再确认发布。
Check key differences, values and delete coverage before publication.

prompt: 旧A=5、B=10；修改B=12并删除A，没有新增。期望总额？
Old A5,B10; update B12 and delete A, with no insert. What is the expected total?

feedback: 旧15+修改2-删除5=12，只剩B。
15+2-5=12, with B alone.
把B12追加到旧15，既保留了旧B又没删A。
This appends B12 to old state without removing stale values.
只加修改差2，却忽略删除A。
This includes the update but ignores deletion.

prompt: 目标P10、Q20；增量新增R15、修改P12、删除Q。列逐键结果与对账清单。
Target P10,Q20; insert R15, update P12, delete Q. Produce expected state and reconciliation checks.
sample: 目标为P12、R15，2键总27；对照同截止全量，检查Q缺席、P只有最新合法版本以及重复重跑结果不变。
Expected P12,R15: two keys,total 27. Compare to full state, verify Q removal and retry equivalence.
criteria: 变更类型和截止版本明确，修改不被误作新增。
Change types and cutoff are explicit; updates are not appended as inserts.
键级对账与总量同时检查，迟到修正通知可追溯。
Key-level and aggregate checks coexist, with traceable late corrections.

title: 数据测试：把规则变成失败行
Data tests: turn expectations into identifiable failing rows
explain: 唯一、非空、外键和业务范围约束回答不同问题。ID没有重复不代表它有值；客户ID有值不代表它能在客户表找到。测试应指出违反了哪条规则的哪些行，使修复可定位，而不是只给“数据质量差”红灯。
Uniqueness, non-null, references and business ranges test different properties. A present customer ID may still be invalid. Failing row IDs make remediation actionable.
测试通过只覆盖已声明的约束。产品金额允许退款为负时，“金额>=0”可能是错误规则；先确认业务用途，再决定阻断发布还是告警。用故意错误输入验证测试真的会失败，比仅对正常样本跑绿灯更有价值。
Passing covers only declared constraints. A non-negative rule may be wrong for refund transactions. Confirm business semantics and use counterexamples to prove checks can fail.

title: 四行订单需要哪几类断言
Four order rows need several distinct assertions
given: 合成教学订单：r1(id=A,customer=C1,amount=10)，r2(id=A,C1,10)，r3(id=NULL,C2,5)，r4(id=D,C9,-1)。本例订单金额须非负，客户表仅C1/C2。
Synthetic rows: r1 A/C1/10, r2 A/C1/10, r3 NULL/C2/5, r4 D/C9/-1. The teaching contract requires non-negative amounts; customers are C1/C2.

title: 各规则独立定位
Locate each violation
detail: 唯一性指出A重复；非空指出r3缺ID；引用检查指出C9无客户；范围检查指出r4金额-1。一个测试不能替代其他测试。
Find duplicate A, missing r3 ID, unknown C9 and r4’s negative amount separately.

title: 隔离与解释
Quarantine with reasons
detail: 失败记录保留原行及规则ID，进入隔离清单；不直接删掉所有失败行以制造“全部通过”的小数据集。
Keep raw rows and rule IDs in quarantine instead of deleting failures to manufacture a passing dataset.

title: 验证修复与反例
Validate repair and counterexamples
detail: 补正ID/来源后复跑全部规则，并留一份A重复的负例确认unique仍会报错。若规则要允许退款负数，需另按交易类型定义。
After correction rerun all rules and retain a duplicate-ID counterexample; refund semantics require a separate rule design.

result: 测试报告说明四类失败、对应行和修复去向；绿灯不被解释为数据绝对真实。
The report maps four violation types to rows and repairs; passing is not proof of absolute truth.

wrong: 只运行unique测试就宣布ID字段完整。
A uniqueness test alone proves IDs are complete.
why: 某些测试或引擎对NULL有不同处理；字段非空必须有明确独立条件。
NULL behavior differs across checks and engines; completeness needs its own predicate.
correct: 把唯一、非空与业务含义分别断言，明确实际引擎行为。
Specify uniqueness, presence and semantics separately for the actual engine.

prompt: ID为A、B、NULL且无重复值。哪项检查仍必要？
IDs A,B,NULL contain no repeated non-null value. Which check remains necessary?

feedback: 3行不能说明每行都有合法身份。
Three rows do not establish valid identity for each.
唯一性与有值是不同性质，NULL必须按契约检测。
Presence and uniqueness are separate requirements.
会制造重复身份且丢失真实来源问题。
This invents identity and creates duplication.

prompt: 输入一条重复event_id、一条未知customer_id、一条超范围amount。设计失败输出与发布门槛。
Design checks for a duplicate event ID, unknown customer and out-of-range amount, including publication gates.
sample: 输出rule_id、raw_row_id、失败值与原因；按业务严重度隔离或阻断，修复后重测正常和反例，不仅统计失败数量。
Emit rule, raw row, value and reason; quarantine or block by declared severity and retest normal/counterexample cases.
criteria: 每项断言对应明确业务条件和可定位失败记录。
Each assertion has an explicit business condition and traceable failures.
用反例证实规则有效，修复不靠删除证据。
Counterexamples demonstrate effectiveness; repairs preserve evidence.

title: 血缘：连接作业、运行与数据版本
Lineage: connect jobs, runs and dataset versions
explain: 作业是处理逻辑，一次运行是该逻辑在某个窗口和版本上的执行，数据集是输入或输出。只画“订单到日报”的箭头，没有说明哪次运行读了哪份数据，无法判断某次故障究竟影响哪天报表。
A job is logic, a run is one execution and a dataset is an input/output. A generic arrow cannot identify the date or version affected by a particular failure.
影响分析应沿实际依赖和发布状态传播。上游失败并不代表所有历史输出都损坏；先查下游读的是失败候选、旧完整版本还是尚未发布的暂存。运行ID、逻辑窗口和输入版本让这项判断有证据。
Propagate impact through actual versions and publication states. Failure does not imply every historical output is corrupt; downstream may still use a prior valid version.

title: 同一作业的两次运行影响不同
Two runs of one job have different consequences
given: 合成链Raw订单S→清洗作业J→数据D→日报K。R1处理5日成功发布D5；R2处理6日失败且未发布，K6仍读取旧D5。
Synthetic S→cleaning J→D→daily report K. R1 publishes D5 for day 5; R2 fails for day 6 without publication, while K6 still reads D5.

title: 把身份分开记录
Separate identities
detail: J是作业名，R1/R2是运行实例，D5是具体输出版本；不能只用J状态“失败”覆盖两次运行。
J identifies the job, R1/R2 executions and D5 a dataset version. One job-level status cannot represent both runs.

title: 追踪消费版本
Trace consumed versions
detail: K6读取D5说明它可能是陈旧而非读取半批坏数据；记录K6的输入版本、期待窗口6日和实际数据窗口5日。
K6 reading D5 signals staleness rather than necessarily partial corruption. Record expected day 6 versus consumed day 5.

title: 列出准确影响与恢复
State precise impact
detail: 5日报表无需因R2失败而一并标错；6日报表需标数据未更新。R2恢复后生成D6并重算K6，再解除陈旧标记。
Day 5 is not invalidated merely by R2. Mark day 6 stale, publish D6 after recovery and recompute K6.

result: 影响记录包含runId、窗口、版本与消费者，避免把一次失败扩成无依据的全历史故障。
Impact records identify run, interval, version and consumer rather than condemning all history.

wrong: 只保留作业名和最新成功/失败灯。
Retain only the job name and latest status.
why: 会失去不同运行和数据版本的关系，无法复现哪份报表使用了什么。
This loses the relationship needed to reproduce a report’s inputs.
correct: 关联Job、Run、Dataset身份和输入输出版本，再沿消费关系分析影响。
Link job, run and dataset identities and follow actual consumption.

prompt: 作业J的新运行失败，但历史报表只读上次已发布完整版本。哪项结论合理？
A new J run fails; historical reports use the prior complete published version. What follows?

text: 所有历史报表都必定坏了
feedback: 没有证据表明历史版本被改变或消费了失败输出。
No evidence shows that historical inputs changed.

text: 完全没有影响，不必调查
feedback: 新窗口可能没有按时更新，仍需调查陈旧性和消费者。
A new interval may be stale and needs investigation.

text: 核消费版本与期待窗口，分别判断历史和新窗口
Check consumed versions and expected intervals
feedback: 数据损坏与更新延迟是不同影响，血缘提供区分依据。
Corruption and staleness are different impacts that lineage helps distinguish.

prompt: 源文件V2更正5日数据，作业产生D5b，月报读取过D5a。画影响链并列需要重算的对象。
Source V2 corrects day 5 and produces D5 b; a monthly report used D5 a. Map the impact and reprocessing.
sample: 记录源V2→清洗运行R→D5b；标识消费D5a的月报运行，重算并对比差额。没有消费旧版本的报表不自动纳入。
Trace V2→R→D5 b and recompute reports that consumed D5 a, comparing differences; do not include unrelated consumers automatically.
criteria: 作业、运行与数据版本的身份各自明确。
Job, run and dataset-version identities are distinct.
受影响消费者有实际依赖依据，恢复能验证新版本已被使用。
Consumer impact follows real dependencies and recovery verifies the new version is consumed.

title: 新鲜度：程序成功不等于数据已可用
Freshness: a successful job is not usable data
explain: 作业结束、数据到达、通过质量检查和对用户可用是不同的时间点。业务要求09:00前能用，08:50程序成功但少了一半来源，不算完成交付。新鲜度应围绕约定数据窗口和真实可用时刻测量。
Job completion, arrival, validation and user availability occur at different times. An early success with missing sources does not meet a usable-data deadline.
恢复不仅要把灯变绿，还应确认数据范围完整、下游已更新且旧/陈旧标记解除。通知应讲清受影响窗口、当前可用版本和下一次检查时间；不能把预计恢复写成实际恢复，更不能为了守时承诺跳过必要验收。
Recovery verifies coverage and downstream refresh, not merely a green status. Communicate affected intervals, current usable version and the next check; estimates are not actual recovery.

title: 08:55成功为何仍晚了25分钟
Why an 08:55 success still misses the deadline
given: 合成要求09:00前数据可用。作业08:55结束，但第二来源09:15才到，09:25质量检查和下游刷新完成。
Synthetic deadline 09:00. Job ends 08:55, second source arrives 09:15 and validation plus downstream refresh finish 09:25.

title: 分开记录时点
Separate milestones
detail: 08:55仅是作业状态；09:15表示输入齐全，仍未证明数据通过检查。不要只取最早的时间。
08:55 is a job milestone;09:15 establishes arrival, not validated availability.

title: 确定可用与延迟
Determine availability
detail: 按本例约定，实际可用时间为09:25，较截止晚25分钟。记录完整数据窗口、来源齐备及质量通过证据。
Availability is 09:25,25 minutes late, supported by coverage and quality evidence.

title: 完成业务恢复
Complete business recovery
detail: 核仪表板确已读取新版本，再解除陈旧提示；保留09:00至09:25的影响记录和后续来源延迟改进。
Verify the dashboard consumes the new version before clearing stale status, retaining the incident interval.

result: 新鲜度报告为晚25分钟，而不是用08:55的程序成功时间声称提前完成。
The delivery is 25 minutes late, not five minutes early based on job completion.

wrong: 看到作业成功就关闭数据延迟事件。
Close the freshness incident when the job succeeds.
why: 这可能掩盖缺来源、未过质量检查或下游仍缓存旧数据的情况。
Sources may be missing, validation incomplete or downstream caches stale.
correct: 用用户可用条件验收，区分预计时间、实际时间和发布版本。
Accept against user availability and distinguish estimates, actual times and versions.

prompt: 截止10:00，作业09:50成功，验证10:10通过，用户10:15可读。按可用时刻延迟多久？
Deadline 10:00; job 09:50, validation 10:10, readable 10:15. What is availability delay?

feedback: 用户直到10:15可用，按此约定计算15分钟。
The declared usable time is 10:15, hence 15 minutes.
只用了作业时间，没有满足可用条件。
This uses job completion rather than availability.
质量通过后仍需5分钟才能供用户读取。
Validation precedes actual readability by five minutes.

prompt: 仪表板需08:00可用，07:50失败、预计重跑20分钟。写当下通知与最终恢复验收。
A dashboard is due 08:00; failure at 07:50, retry estimated 20 minutes. Write notification and recovery acceptance.
sample: 通知可能逾期、影响窗口及当前旧版状态，08:10只是预计；实际恢复须确认输入齐、质量通过、下游新版本可读后记录时间与延迟。
Warn of likely lateness, affected interval and current version.08:10 is an estimate; record recovery only after validated data reach consumers.
criteria: 成功、到达、验证、发布与可用时间没有混为一谈。
Execution, arrival, validation, publication and availability are distinct.
恢复有真实下游验收与影响记录，而非只关闭告警。
Recovery includes downstream evidence and impact records.

title: 先定义任务，再给模型一个可比较的起点
Define the task before choosing a model
explain: 预测任务需要明确预测对象、作出判断的时刻、目标标签与可用输入。例如“收到工单时判断是否需升级”，只能使用当时已知信息；后续人工结论可以做标签，却不能提前作为输入。否则模型似乎很准，只是偷看了答案。
Define the entity, decision time, label and available inputs. For ticket triage at receipt, later staff outcomes can be labels but not contemporaneous inputs.
基线是固定、简单且可重复的策略，用于判断复杂模型是否带来实际增益。类别不平衡时，全部预测多数类也可能有高准确率；还要看少数高风险类别的漏检与误报。基线记录应与候选使用同一评估集和指标。
A baseline is a fixed reproducible policy. A majority-class predictor can have high accuracy while missing every costly minority case. Compare candidates on the same held-out inputs and metrics.

title: 90%准确率为什么可能一点忙也没帮上
Why 90% accuracy may provide no useful detection
given: 合成100条工单：90条普通、10条需要升级；基线全部预测普通。新规则找出8条真正升级，也误报了6条普通。
Synthetic 100 tickets:90 ordinary,10 escalation. Baseline predicts all ordinary; a new rule finds 8 true escalations and flags 6 ordinary tickets.

title: 算简单基线
Calculate the baseline
detail: 基线正确90条，准确率90%；但升级召回0/10=0%。它适合作为比较起点，不适合作为“已解决升级识别”的证据。
The baseline is 90% accurate but has 0% escalation recall; it is a benchmark, not useful escalation detection.

title: 算候选的业务代价
Measure candidate errors
detail: 新规则TP8、FN2、FP6、TN84；准确率92%，升级召回80%，精确率8/14≈57.14%。人工需复查14条。
The rule has TP 8,FN 2,FP 6,TN 84:92% accuracy,80% recall and precision about 57.14%;14 tickets need review.

title: 按任务比较
Compare against the task
detail: 若漏升级代价高，新规则可能值得进一步验证，但需评估6次误报占用的人工容量。不能只看准确率比90%多2点。
If misses are costly, investigate the rule while accounting for six false alarms and reviewer capacity.

result: 基线与候选同时列准确率、漏检、误报及复查量，任务收益才可讨论。
Compare accuracy, misses, false alarms and review burden before discussing value.

wrong: 全部预测普通已有90%准确率，所以不需要识别升级工单。
The 90%-accurate majority predictor solves escalation triage.
why: 准确率由90条普通工单主导，10条真正需要行动的工单全被漏掉。
Ordinary tickets dominate the metric while every actionable case is missed.
correct: 按风险类别列混淆矩阵与代价，再与固定基线比较。
Use class-specific errors and costs alongside the fixed baseline.

prompt: 200例中10例需升级；全预测普通。升级召回率是多少？
Ten of 200 cases need escalation. Predicting all ordinary gives what escalation recall?

feedback: 95%是整体准确率，不是升级召回。
95% is overall accuracy, not escalation recall.
5%是正类在样本中的占比，不是找回比例。
5% is prevalence, not recovery of positives.
10个真实升级一个都没找回，0/10=0%。
None of the ten positives was recovered.

prompt: 为“工单收到时预测是否需升级”写任务卡，列简单基线、当时可用字段和两类错误代价。
Write a triage task card with a baseline, available-at-receipt fields and costs for both error types.
sample: 对象为工单，时间为收到时；输入可含当时文本，标签为后续复核结果；不能输入复核结论。基线固定为关键词规则或多数类，报告漏检/误报及复核容量。
Use ticket/receipt time, initial text and later reviewed labels, excluding future outcomes from inputs. Fix a keyword or majority baseline and report both error costs.
criteria: 预测时刻与字段可得性明确，标签未泄漏进输入。
Decision time and feature availability are explicit; labels do not leak into inputs.
基线可重复、评估集一致且包含少数风险类别指标。
Baseline and comparison data are fixed, with minority-risk metrics.

title: Python准备：保留原值才知道错在哪里
Python preparation: retain raw values to explain failures
explain: CSV里的“0007”可能是标识符而不是整数7；自动类型推断会丢掉前导零。读取时应按字段用途指定类型。日期为空与日期字符串“bad”都可能解析成缺失标记，但前者是原始缺失，后者是有值却非法，修复责任不同。
A CSV identifier such as 0007 is not necessarily the number 7. Explicit types preserve identity. Empty dates and malformed populated dates can both parse as missing but represent different problems.
可复现的准备流程保留raw列，并分别生成缺失、非法、转换后值。先判断原字符串是否为空，再执行日期解析，才能在coerce后仍区分错误类别。不要把无法解析的日期自动填成今天，那会制造不存在的发生时间。
Keep raw columns and separate missing, invalid and parsed outputs. Detect original emptiness before coercion; never replace failed parsing with today’s date as an observed fact.

title: 三个ID与两种日期问题
Three IDs and two distinct date problems
given: 合成CSV行：0007/2026-02-01，0008/bad，0009/空白。ID要求保留4位字符串，日期格式要求YYYY-MM-DD。
Synthetic CSV:0007/2026-02-01,0008/bad,0009/blank. IDs are four-character strings and dates use YYYY-MM-DD.

title: 保留输入含义
Preserve input meaning
detail: 以字符串读取ID和raw_date，明确空白读取规则；确认0007仍长4位。不要在转换前覆盖原列。
Read IDs and raw dates as strings with explicit empty-value handling;0007 must retain four characters.

title: 区分缺失与解析失败
Separate absence from failure
detail: raw_date为空的0009记missing=true；对非空日期按给定格式解析并把失败记invalid。0008为invalid=true、missing=false。
0009 is missing. Parse populated dates with the specified format;0008 is invalid but not originally missing.

title: 输出可审计准备结果
Emit auditable preparation
detail: 0007解析为有效日期，两标记false；0008日期未知、invalid=true；0009日期未知、missing=true。三条原始文本与转换规则一起保存。
0007 parses successfully;0008 is invalid and 0009 missing. Preserve all raw text and transformation rules.

result: 转换后的未知值有不同原因，ID未丢零，后续清洗能找到真正该修的来源。
Unknown parsed values retain distinct reasons and IDs retain leading zeroes.

wrong: 两行都解析失败，就统一标“原始日期缺失”。
Call every unparsed date originally missing.
why: 会掩盖bad这种源值质量错误，也失去追查格式、导出和解析规则的依据。
This hides malformed source content and prevents format investigation.
correct: 保留raw_date，先判原始缺失，再记录解析失败。
